title: Key Account Manager
description: VIL OG KAN DU UDVIKLE STÆRKE KUNDERELATIONER OG DRIVE KOMMERCIEL VÆKST FOR EVA TRIO & EVA SOLO?       OM EVA TRIO   Eva Trio er en dansk designvirksomhed bag to stærke brands: Eva Trio og Eva Solo. Vi udvikler og markedsfører produkter til køkken, bord og bolig, hvor funktionalitet, æstetik og kvalitet går hånd i hånd. Med afsæt i dansk designtradition og et internationalt udsyn skaber vi produkter, der gør hverdagen smukkere, enklere og mere inspirerende. Vi er midt i en spændende udvikling, hvor stærke partnerskaber og en tydelig digital tilstedeværelse er centrale for vores fortsatte vækst.      DIN ROLLE   Som Key Account Manager får du en central rolle i at udvikle samarbejdet med udvalgte nøglekunder, danske kæder og e-tailers i Skandinavien. Du får ansvar for at drive salget, udvikle kunderne kommercielt og sikre, at Eva Trio og Eva Solo står stærkt på tværs af både fysiske og digitale salgskanaler.     Du refererer til Head of Sales, Scandinavia og bliver en del af en ambitiøs salgsorganisation, hvor samarbejde, professionalisme og eksekvering er afgørende. Rollen kombinerer strategisk kundearbejde med en stærk operationel tilgang, og du vil arbejde tæt sammen med kollegaer på tværs af salg, marketing, supply chain og kundeservice for at skabe resultater og sikre høj kundetilfredshed.     Du trives med en dynamisk hverdag, hvor struktur, forberedelse, klar kommunikation og opfølgning er nøglen til succes. Du arbejder målrettet med kundeudvikling, salgsplanlægning, sortiment, kampagner og performance – og du har blik for både vækstpotentiale, brandpositionering og stærke relationer.      DINE PRIMÆRE ANSVARSOMRÅDER    Udvikle og eksekvere salgs- og kundeplaner for udvalgte nøglekunder, kæder og e-tailers  Drive budget, forecast, opfølgning og løbende markedsrapportering  Gennemføre årsforhandlinger, nyhedspræsentationer og løbende kundemøder  Arbejde strategisk med sortiment, kategorianalyser, kampagneplanlægning og salgsperformance  Identificere vækstmuligheder og omsætte dem til konkrete resultater  Styrke relationer til centrale beslutningstagere og nøglefunktioner hos kunderne  Sikre optimal præsentation af brandene Eva Trio og Eva Solo på kundernes digitale platforme og i fysiske butikker  Anvende salgsdata, digitale værktøjer og markedsindsigter til at skabe målrettede initiativer  Samarbejde tæt med marketing om kampagner, produktmateriale, content og synlighed  Deltage i messer, kundearrangementer og relevante brancheaktiviteter       DIN PROFIL   Du er kommercielt stærk, har flair for at knytte tætte kunderelationer og er målrettet. Du har erfaring med at udvikle kunder og skabe vækst gennem struktur, forberedelse, godt købmandsskab og en professionel tilgang til salgsarbejdet. Du trives med ansvar, arbejder selvstændigt og formår samtidig at skabe gode samarbejder på tværs af organisationen.  Du har naturlig interesse for brands, produkter og forbrugeradfærd, og du forstår værdien af at kombinere stærke kunderelationer me

title: Key Account Manager
description: At Vitec Autosystemer, you will play a key role in our continued growth in Norway. You will be the commercial link between our customers, the Norwegian organization, and our product teams, with a significant opportunity to influence both the business and the development of our solutions.  If you thrive in a role with a high degree of autonomy and want to make a real impact in a company where your ideas can be turned into reality, this is an exciting opportunity.      About the role   As Key Account Manager, you will take commercial ownership of our established customer base of independent workshops, workshop chains, and parts wholesalers across Norway. Your main focus will be to ensure that these customers derive lasting value from our solutions. This is not a traditional new-business role: new deals are welcome when they arise, but they are not the only focus.     You will hold the only commercial role in the Norwegian organization, giving you a high degree of freedom and responsibility, as well as a real opportunity to influence how the business develops. You will work closely with skilled colleagues in support, product development, and delivery, and your line manager is based in Finland.      Examples of responsibilities    Manage and develop an established customer portfolio in Norway  Lead customer meetings, product demonstrations, and workshops  Drive renewals, upselling activities, and customer satisfaction  Identify customer needs and translate them into business opportunities  Contribute market and customer insights to product development  Provide customer and commercial perspectives to guide the adaptation and development of our solutions for the Norwegian market       Who are you?   We believe you enjoy combining commercial thinking with relationship building. You are self-driven, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of your work. At the same time, you are curious about your customers' business and motivated by creating long-term value rather than pursuing short-term wins.      To succeed in this role, we would like you to have:    Experience managing and developing existing customer relationships  A background in B2B sales to small or medium-sized businesses  Experience selling software, SaaS, ERP solutions, or other business-critical systems  The ability to conduct customer presentations and needs analyses independently  A structured way of working and experience managing a large customer portfolio  Fluency in Norwegian, both spoken and written, and a good command of English       It is an advantage if you have experience in:    The automotive industry or aftermarket sector  Wholesale or distribution businesses  Business management systems or workshop management solutions  Product development or gathering customer requirements       Why Vitec Autosystemer AS? Vi styrker vårt Account Management-team og søker nå en  Account Manager for metallindustrien i Norge . I rollen blir du en strategisk samarbeidspartner for kundene våre og et viktig bindeledd mellom kunden og ABBs ulike fagmiljøer. For å lykkes tror vi du har god forståelse for industri, teknologi og kommersielle prosesser, og evner å se hvordan ABB kan skape verdi gjennom hele kundens livssyklus.  Stillingen rapporterer til  Head of Account Management i Service Sales-organisasjonen , og du vil samarbeide tett med kolleger innen blant annet salg, service, prosjekter, produkter og øvrige fagmiljøer.   Dine viktigste ansvarsområder     Ha ansvar for og videreutvikle ABBs kundestrategi for en portefølje av kunder innen norsk metallindustri.  Bygge langsiktige og tillitsbaserte relasjoner med sentrale beslutningstakere og kontaktpersoner hos kundene, fra operative og tekniske miljøer til ledelse og innkjøp.  Opparbeide inngående forståelse for kundenes strategi, installerte base, investeringsplaner, operative utfordringer og bærekraftsmål.  Utarbeide, vedlikeholde og gjennomføre kunde- og segmentplaner som støtter både kundenes prioriteringer og ABBs forretningsmål.  Identifisere, kvalifisere og utvikle nye forretningsmuligheter innen blant annet service, oppgraderinger, prosjekter, automasjon, elektrifisering og digitale løsninger.  Lede og koordinere tverrfaglige kundeteam og sikre tydelig ansvar, god oppfølging og en helhetlig tilnærming til kunden.  Samarbeide med interne fagmiljøer for å utvikle konkurransedyktige verdiforslag og bidra til god gjennomføring og oppfølging gjennom hele kundelivssyklusen.  Følge opp kommersielle og operative problemstillinger og koordinere nødvendige tiltak for å sikre kundetilfredshet og styrke kunderelasjonen.  Representere ABB i relevante kundefora, bransjenettverk og markedsaktiviteter, samt dele markeds- og kundeinnsikt internt. Dokumentert evne til å bygge sterke kunderelasjoner, koordinere ulike interessenter og skape målbare forretningsresultater.  Bachelor- eller mastergrad innen tekniske, økonomiske

Capacità di analisi dei dati e interpretazione degli insight.   Esperienza nella gestione di progetti trasversali.   Capacità di collaborazione con team multidisciplinari.   Eccellenti competenze comunicative, relazionali e di ascolto.   Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Aero Alliance Customer Fulfilment and Experience Leader to join our Gas Power team based in Avenza (Carrara). We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver. Managing the end-to-end customer site visit experience, serving as the single point of contact to ensure professional and impactful engagements.     Skills For Success

Extraer aprendizajes y convertirlos en decisiones que mejoren las siguientes activaciones y la evolución de MMBRS Community.       ¿Cómo te imaginamos? title: Customer Success Manager
description: Descriptif du poste  Nos clients nous confient une part importante de leur patrimoine. Ils attendent un niveau de service de banque privée. Tu ne traites pas des tickets :  tu construis l'expérience client d'une banque privée qui veut servir des centaines de milliers de clients avec une équipe resserrée. title: Global Customer Platform Manager (f/m/x)
description: Shape how Blum wins and grows with its most important global customers.   Serving our most important global customers involves almost every part of Blum, from sales and product development to manufacturing, supply chain and senior leadership. Success means acting as one organisation. Our Global Customer Platform makes this possible. It is a network of teams, processes, decision making and initiatives that turns customer priorities into action across Blum.  As Global Customer Platform Manager, you will lead this platform and become the go-to partner for advancing the global customer agenda. Working closely with the Global Key Account Manager, you will make sure that what the customer says externally is implemented internally at Blum.   YOU WILL      shape the Global Customer Platform: define how Blum organises, collaborates and makes decisions around its most important global customers  embed customer priorities in core processes, from product development to our global manufacturing and supply network  drive decisions at senior level: bring the right topics to senior management and turn them into clear decisions and action  mobilise stakeholders across Blum: bring sales, marketing, product, manufacturing, distribution and supply chain together around shared priorities  turn complexity into action: structure complex topics, clarify priorities and drive cross-functional initiatives forward      WE     are seeking an individual with experience: around 10 years in an international industrial or B2B environment, ideally in key account management, corporate development, consulting or programme management  value strategic thinking: you see the bigger picture and translate customer priorities into clear actions for the wider business  welcome candidates who can influence without authority: you build trusted relationships, bring senior stakeholders together and move complex topics forward  prize effective communication skills: you present confidently and persuasively, from operational experts to the Executive Board  are offering a position that requires cross-functional leadership: you have led initiatives or programmes across organisational boundaries in a global setup  attach importance to a good education: you will have a degree in business or a related field, or equivalent professional experience  operate globally: fluent business English is required and German language skills are nice to have      WHY WORK ORANGE?     Shape something new Build the model rather than inherit it, in a newly created role  Connect customer priorities with decisions across products, manufacturing, supply chain and sales  Think long term Join a family-owned company with a strong brand and a long-term perspective     You can find more information about WORK ORANGE here  Legally binding note: The actual salary is above the metalworkers' collective agreement and is based on professional qualifications and experience as well as the Vorarlberg labor market.

title: Care Ecosystem Activation Manager
description: 想像を超える挑戦を、どのように実現しますか？  アムジェンは、40年以上にわたり革新的な成果を生み出してきたバイオテクノロジー企業です。科学への取り組みを通じて、患者さんの生活を大きく改善する新しい治療法を発見・開発してきました。また、こうした治療法を世界中に届けるため、先進的な製造体制や支援サービスにも投資しています。日本を含むアジア太平洋（JAPAC）地域は、アムジェンの中でも最も成長の速い地域です。このたび、 Care Ecosystem Activation Mgr としてご活躍いただける方を募集します。  職務内容  担当業務  Care Ecosystem Activation Mgrはマーケティング部門に所属し、担当エリアおよび戦略アカウントの関係者と協働して、心血管疾患の診療を支えるケアエコシステムの構築と定着を進めます。  本JDでいう「ケアエコシステム」とは、患者さんを中心に、医療従事者と医療機関をつなぎ、患者さんへの教育や継続的なフォローアップを含む仕組みです。この職務では、急性冠症候群（ACS）および慢性冠症候群（CCS）の診療について、医療従事者や医療機関が、それぞれの施設に合った院内のケアエコシステムを開発・改善・導入し、実際の診療で継続して活用できるよう支援します。  Care Ecosystem Activation Leadにレポートし、プロダクトマネージャー、メディカル、営業と連携します。多職種・複数施設間の協働を促し、病院内のチームと退院後のケアを担う関係者との連携を支援します。  担当エリアおよび戦略アカウントにおける活動の進捗と成果に責任を持ちます。施設ごとの課題や治療上のギャップを分析し、関係者とアクションプランを策定・実行します。また、KPIに基づいて成果を評価し、改善につなげるための市場インサイトや導入時の学びを共有します。 Vision    To become the go-to merchandising tool for fashion retailers, so they're more profitable, shoppers get a better experience, and the planet is harmed less.     Who are we     We're a 12-year-old Spanish scale-up with a startup mentality, building advanced AI/ML technology for the fashion retail industry. title: Digital Customer Success Associate
description: Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.  As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration. Your responsibilities will include responding to customer requests, identifying opportunities for growth, and collaborating with internal teams to enhance the self-service  experience. Additionally, you will be actively involved in analyzing data to identify potential leads for the sales department.  Overall, the Digital Customer Success Associate role requires a proactive and analytical approach to ensure the success of self-service  customers and drive continuous improvement in lead generation and conversion processes. Strong communication skills, attention to detail,  and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams are essential for success in this role.   Key Responsibilities      Manage Self-Service Customers: Actively engage with self-service customers to ensure their needs are met and they achieve success using our digital products and services. title: Entry level Customer Success Manager (€30-€60k salary + commission)
description: We’re looking for entry level graduates, non-graduates and career changers as Tangent’s network grows globally across London, Barcelona, Berlin, Amsterdam and more. The starting salary is €30-€60k + commission.       What is Tangent      Tangent has created a new way to apply for jobs where industry expert mentors already working in the best companies provide free mentoring and support through the application process. On Tangent jobseekers sign-up and then connect with mentors for help with their CV, applications, industry advice and even support with salary negotiations. In today’s job market it’s almost impossible to get hired without the help of a mentor, they’ve been through the process in their career and want to give back by volunteering.     Tangent is a social impact platform built to help socially diverse backgrounds break into tech. Only 9% of tech employees come from low socioeconomic backgrounds, despite them making up 39% of the total population! That's worse than law, consulting and banking! We’re on a mission to change this and we need your help!     No previous experience or a degree is required, just a passion for the mission - helping jobseekers get hired with the help of a mentor      What you’ll do:        Client Onboarding:  Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and successful introduction to Tangent's services.   Relationship Management:  Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with assigned clients, acting as their trusted advisor.   Understanding Client Needs:  Proactively understand your clients' business objectives, challenges, and desired outcomes.   Value Demonstration:  Demonstrate the value of Tangent's services by providing regular updates, insights, and best practice recommendations.   Adoption and Engagement:  Drive product adoption and engagement through training, support, and proactive communication.   Problem Solving:  Identify and resolve client issues promptly and effectively, escalating where necessary.   Retention and Growth:  Work to reduce churn and identify opportunities to expand client accounts.   Feedback Collection:  Gather client feedback and share insights with the product and development teams to improve our services.   Advocacy:  Encourage clients to become advocates for Tangent through testimonials, case studies, and referrals.   Performance Tracking:  Monitor client health metrics and proactively address any potential issues to ensure success.   Reporting:  Prepare and deliver regular client reports, highlighting key achievements and areas for improvement.       Why Join Tangent?        Competitive Salary and Commission:  Earn a competitive base salary plus uncapped commission based on performance. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package.   Make a Real Impact:  You'll be directly contributing to our mission of helping jobseekers get hired with the help of a mentor   Career Growth:  We're a rapidly growing company with plenty of opportunitie

description: Placeringsort: Eskilstuna, Kalmar, Karlskrona, Karlstad, Jönköping, Linköping, Norrköping, Nyköping, Skara, Västerås, Växjö, Örebro, Borlänge, Gävle, Luleå, Piteå, Kiruna, Umeå, Skellefteå, Sundsvall, Örnsköldsvik, Östersund   Vill du ta nästa steg i karriären och kombinera affärsdriv med struktur, noggrannhet och starka kundrelationer? Du arbetar nära kund- och konsultteamen samt leverantören för att förstå kundens behov och identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter.  Rollen kräver god struktur, noggrannhet och affärsmässig precision. Du hanterar projekt, tar fram resursförslag samt planerar och följer upp utförandet där säkerställer hög kvalitet i våra leveranser.  Till din hjälp har du ett av IT-branschens starkaste varumärken, ett nära samarbete med en marknadsledande leverantör och kompetenta team som tillsammans arbetar för att utveckla långsiktiga och värdeskapande kundrelationer.   Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter i rollen är att:     Löpande skapa samt uppdatera underlag så att Atea bygger rätt kompetens och tar rätt certifieringar för att genomföra både Broadcom PSO och andra leveransuppdrag. Underlag delges regionala KC inom Hybrid att agera på.  Löpande upprätthålla underlag så att Atea proaktivt kan bemanna PSO-uppdrag. description: Die BKW bietet ihren Kundinnen und Kunden international Gesamtlösungen in den Bereichen Energie, Gebäude und Infrastruktur an. Wir beschäftigen rund 11'500 Mitarbeitende. Gemeinsam bauen wir Netze, produzieren Energie, planen und realisieren energieeffiziente Gebäude und gestalten nachhaltige Lebensräume von morgen. Dazu brauchen wir Sie: Menschen mit Ideen und Engagement. Leisten Sie mit uns einen wertvollen Beitrag für die Gesellschaft und unsere Umwelt!     Operations Manager BESS (alle)     80-100%  Du verbindest Projekt und Betrieb und sorgst dafür, dass aus einem Projekt eine betriebsbereite Anlage wird. Als zentrale Schnittstelle stellst du sicher, dass die Anforderungen früh einfliessen und neue BESS-Anlagen technisch, organisatorisch und sicher für den kommerziellen Betrieb bereit sind.     Dein Wirkungsfeld     Du koordinierst die Betriebsvorbereitung neuer BESS-Anlagen von der Planung bis zur Übergabe in den kommerziellen Betrieb   Als Bindeglied zwischen Projekt- und Betriebsorganisation bringst du betriebliche Anforderungen ein und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit von Planer, Betreiber und Lieferanten   Zusammen mit dem Projektteam definierst du die Kriterien für die Betriebsbereitschaft, koordinierst Operational-Readiness-Checks und stellst die strukturierte Übergabe an den Betrieb sicher   Betriebs-, Wartungs-, Sicherheits- und Notfallkonzepte sowie die dazugehörige Dokumentation stellst du gemeinsam mit den relevanten Fachstellen sicher   Risiken, offene Punkte und Pendenzen behältst du im Blick, treibst deren Bearbeitung voran und eskalierst kritische Abweichungen frühzeitig   Als ergänzende Aufgabe übernimmst du gemeinsam mit einem andern Teammitglied die Rolle als Local Cyber Security Officers und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung relevanter Vorgaben und Massnahmen       Das bringst du mit     Du verfügst über eine technische Ausbildung oder ein Studium, vorzugsweise in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Automation oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung   Erfahrung im Betrieb, in der Inbetriebnahme oder im Projektmanagement komplexer Energie- oder technischer Anlagen bringst du mit; BESS-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus   Schnittstellen- und Stakeholdermanagement liegen dir und du verstehst es, unterschiedliche Fachstellen zielgerichtet zusammenzubringen   Technische und organisatorische Zusammenhänge erfasst du schnell und gehst Herausforderungen strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und selbstständig an   Mit deiner klaren Kommunikation, deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinem Durchsetzungsvermögen vertrittst du betriebliche Anforderungen auch gegenüber unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen   Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein prägen deine Arbeitsweise und du denkst über Organisations- und Fachbereichsgrenzen hinweg       Fragen zur Bewerbung   Jasmin Gut Recruiting Partner jasmin.gut@bkw.ch   Fragen zur Stelle   Marcel Bühlmann Managing Director Business Unit BESS marcel.buehlmann@bkw.ch  Wir wünschen keine Anfragen von

title: COMMISSIONING MANAGER
description: Il nostro Cliente è un’azienda imprenditoriale in crescita specializzata a livello internazionale nella progettazione e produzione di soluzioni di automazione industriale su commessa. Per rafforzare la propria struttura Operations ci ha commissionato la ricerca di un:       COMMISSIONING MANAGER      Il candidato, riportando al Direttore Operations, avrà un ruolo chiave nel coordinamento delle attività di commissioning degli impianti, collaborando quotidianamente con reparti produttivi, Ufficio Tecnico e Ufficio Commerciale.  Ricerchiamo una persona autorevole e pragmatica, con forte credibilità tecnica e personale e capacità di collaborare efficacemente con i reparti produttivi e l’Ufficio Tecnico.      Responsabilità principali:   • Gestire il commissioning degli impianti, coordinando le attività di collaudo interno, installazione, collaudo e avviamento presso il cliente.  • Assicurare il rispetto delle tempistiche e degli obiettivi delle commesse più critiche.  • Collaborare con il Responsabile di Produzione, fungendo da punto di riferimento operativo.  • Coordinare funzionalmente le attività dell’area Produzione durante le fasi di assemblaggio, avviamento e messa in servizio.  • Garantire il rispetto delle specifiche tecniche, dei tempi e dei costi di progetto, coordinando le diverse funzioni aziendali coinvolte e assicurando il corretto avanzamento delle attività fino alla messa in servizio dell'impianto.  • Coordinare le risorse di Back Office dedicate all'organizzazione delle attività di commissioning.      Requisiti:   • Laurea in Ingegneria o Diploma a indirizzo tecnico.  • Esperienza pluriennale in ruoli di responsabilità nell'ambito del commissioning, della produzione/pianificazione produzione o del project management, maturata in aziende che progettano e realizzano macchinari, impianti o linee automatiche/robotizzate su commessa.  • Solida conoscenza delle dinamiche di costruzione e assemblaggio di macchinari e impianti industriali.  • Gradita esperienza su automazione industriale.  • Ottime doti relazionali, spiccate capacità organizzative e operative, orientamento al risultato, senso di responsabilità, leadership.  • Buona dimestichezza con software gestionali.  • Conoscenza della lingua inglese.     Sede di lavoro: Provincia Nord di Treviso.  Lavoro in presenza.     Range di RAL indicativo offerto: € 60.000-65.000.     L’annuncio è rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi, nel rispetto della normativa vigente. I dati personali saranno trattati esclusivamente per le finalità connesse alla selezione, nel rispetto della normativa vigente in materia di protezione dei dati personali.

title: Market Manager
description: About the role:    Remote, based in Japan      Own a portfolio of directly contracted hotels across Japan, and decide how far you can take it.  Nuitée is growing its direct hotel supply across Japan, and this is the next portfolio ready for someone to take full ownership of.     As Market Manager, you'll be the go-to person for every hotel partner you manage: setting the commercial strategy, keeping pricing and availability sharp, and making sure each property is fully activated and performing.     You'll work hand in hand with hotel revenue managers, GMs, and cluster teams, using Nuitée's dashboards to catch performance gaps early and turn them into fixes before they cost bookings.     It's a hands-on, high-ownership role, and one where near-native Japanese and real knowledge of the local hotel market aren't nice-to-haves — they're what it takes to run commercial conversations with Japanese hotel partners and actually move pricing and promotions forward.      What makes it interesting for you:    You own the commercial strategy for your own portfolio: pricing, promotions, availability, and which hotels get switched back on  You're the direct link between Nuitée and hotel revenue managers and GMs — no layers in between  You work hands-on with real-time performance dashboards built for fast decisions, not static reporting  Nuitée's direct supply team keeps growing, and Japan is one of the regions it's investing in next — early ownership here comes with room to grow as the portfolio scales      Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, stayed profitable the entire time, and raised a $48M Series A led by Accel. Demand partners like Grab and Priceline already send bookings through Nuitée's platform, and direct supply — the inventory you'd own — is a growing priority for where that demand gets filled.      The kind of problems you'll work on:    How do you get a newly signed hotel fully live and producing bookings, fast?  What's actually holding a specific hotel back — price, availability, or something more structural?  How do you turn a dashboard full of data into the two or three things worth fixing today?  How do you build a quarterly account plan a hotel partner actually finds useful?  How do you keep an issue moving until it's closed, instead of letting it sit?       This role fits someone who:    Has 5+ years specifically in a Market Manager, Area Manager, or equivalent portfolio-ownership role at an OTA, bedbank, or hotel-distribution platform  Is native or fluent in Japanese, with real working knowledge of the Japan hotel and travel market  Lives comfortably in dashboards and turns data into action instead of just tracking it  Understands hotel pricing, inventory, and connectivity well enough to spot exactly what's broken  Is highly organized and execution-driven — issues on your desk get closed, not carried into next week      You will do well here if you're proactive, hands-on, and move with a real sense of urgency. Fournir des solutions de haute qualité dans les délais et le budget prévus.  Être force de proposition avec la mise en œuvre de solutions innovantes, efficaces en adéquation avec les enjeux clients. title: Senior Engineer - High Performance Data Systems
description:
About Encord

Encord is the universal data layer for AI. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates and evaluates multimodal data across the full AI lifecycle, from development to production, for 300+ AI teams including Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath and Zipline.

Encord was founded by former computer scientists, physicists and quants who saw first-hand how poor tooling for training data slows AI progress. We're a Series C company backed by CRV and Y Combinator, with 150+ people across London, San Francisco and New York.

The role

Most engineers never get to redesign core infrastructure for the next 100x of scale. On Foundations, that's the job.

AI teams are generating video, images, 3D sensor data and documents faster than anyone's systems can keep up. Help us build the high-performance data systems behind the AI data platform for robotics and beyond.

description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

You own the testing of your own designs, and your results decide what flies.

title: Revenue Operations Lead
description:
The Role We Need

PadSplit's demand engine spans Marketing, Lifecycle, Member Acquisition, and Member Success, but no one owns how these teams connect once a lead is approved, leaving us blind to where members stall on the way to a move-in and unable to see which outreach actually converts. We need a Revenue Operations Lead to own the last, most critical leg of the funnel: the calling and human outreach that turns an approved lead into a housed member, along with the reporting that makes the whole funnel legible. This role starts narrow (conversion and outreach) with room to expand into the broader Demand Growth function over time.

The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for a builder-operator with 5+ years in revenue operations, growth operations, or funnel analytics, who is fluent in SQL or a BI tool like Hex, Mode, or Looker and has real instinct for calling operations, script testing, and agent coaching. This person uses AI daily to build reporting, analyze calls, and scale outreach, and has a clear point of view on where AI makes an ops team faster. They can hold many channels at once without losing the thread, and translate a messy funnel into decisions leadership can act on.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day:

  • Optimizing call performance: Own how members convert across AI-driven calls and human phone calls, refining scripts, follow-up cadence, and objection handling.
  • Coaching agents: Test what actually moves conversion and feed findings back to human agents and the teams they support.
  • Sequencing hand-offs: Decide where AI calls hand off to a person and where a person hands off to Lifecycle.
  • Building funnel dashboards: Maintain the end-to-end view of the demand funnel — lead to approved to booked to moved-in — primarily in Hex.
  • Closing reporting gaps: Surface stage-by-stage conversion, drop-off, and velocity without re-deriving data each time.
  • Driving retention outreach: Partner with Member Success to flag churn-risk changes and behavioral events, and proactively reach out before a member decides to leave.
  • Standing up interventions: Launch retention and transfer offers as caller campaigns or lifecycle text messages.
  • Fixing the stack: Bring order to lead routing, CRM hygiene, and experiment instrumentation, and set clear SLAs across Performance Marketing, Lifecycle, MA, and Member Success.

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful:

  • RevOps background: 5+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, growth operations, or funnel analytics, ideally in a marketplace, subscription, or high-volume consumer-sales environment.

title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation.

The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.

Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the role

At Gravis, the intelligence behind our machines is only as good as the systems that develop, train, and operate it. The Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into a learning-based control system that adapts in real time to changing ground conditions. As our fleet grows and our models become more sophisticated, we need world-class infrastructure to support the full ML lifecycle: from raw sensor data ingestion on the edge to continuous model training, evaluation, and deployment at scale.

title: Technical Marketing Engineer
description:
The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Process Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. 

At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Process Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. 

The role will have a strong focus on dry etching processes, particularly ICP and RIE, as well as PECVD and metal evaporation. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Process Development & Industrialization 

  • Develop, optimize and stabilize semiconductor fabrication processes, with a primary focus on ICP / RIE dry etching, PECVD deposition and metal evaporation.

title: Senior Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Engineering the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

The Demand Core team builds the infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open our ad unit Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure, downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. You will build and operate the services that power these decisions 200 million times every day.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals, geo, fraud status, budget caps to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. Beyond campaign distribution, the team owns the entire ad interaction chain: processing clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer, and in-app events that trigger rewards. These events are broadcasted through a hybrid messaging architecture using SNS/SQS and Kafka, directly powering our advertiser dashboards, publisher reward payouts, and ad campaign scoring pipelines, all backed by DynamoDB.

title: Senior Conversion Design Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

We're looking for a Senior Conversion Design Analyst who is genuinely both things: a designer who digs into data, and an analyst who designs. You decide with evidence. You will frame real user problems based on qualitative and quantitative data, design a part of our product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and analyze the results yourself.

You will sit inside the product delivery team that focuses on user growth, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it. And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them.
  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle
  • Design, run the experiment, read it honestly and decide what comes next. Define a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. Then use what you learned to frame the next question. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and designing the next step.
  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Are you an experienced Customer Success professional who loves turning customers into long-term partners, and are you looking for work with real purpose?  At ChurchDesk – now also including Hagru – we are growing in the Netherlands and are looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our team in Groningen.  You'll own a portfolio of Dutch churches and congregations that already use Hagru or ChurchDesk. You'll onboard them, make sure the platform truly supports their daily work, and grow those accounts by showing them where else ChurchDesk can add value.   Does this sound like you?   You know what great customer success looks like: structured onboarding, proactive account management, healthy retention and well-timed expansion conversations. You're equally comfortable walking a volunteer through their first login and discussing an upgrade with a church council. You don't need a church background. What matters is that you're curious about our customers' world and genuinely motivated by helping them succeed.  Your Role: Onboarding, Advisory and Growth    Onboard new customers: You guide churches through setup and training to their first successes, so they feel confident from day one.  Own your portfolio: You're the main point of contact for your customers, understand their workflows and goals, and help them get the most out of the platform.  Drive adoption and retention: You monitor usage and customer health, spot risks early and act proactively.  Grow your accounts: You identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities and lead those conversations confidently, with a focus on real customer value.  Be the voice of the customer: You share insights with our product and sales teams to help shape ChurchDesk for the Dutch market.  Proven Customer Success experience: Several years in customer success, account management or a similar role, ideally in B2B SaaS.  Commercial drive: A track record of retaining customers and growing accounts through upselling or cross-selling.  Onboarding and training skills: You can explain software clearly to people with very different levels of digital experience.  Structured and independent: You manage your portfolio with clear priorities, follow-ups and measurable results.  Curiosity for our customers' world: No church background needed, but you're genuinely interested in how churches work and enjoy building trust with them. Experience in the non-profit or church sector is a plus.  Strong communication skills: You are fluent in Dutch and have a good command of English.     What We Offer     A role in a growing company with a strong focus on personal and professional development — including access to a dedicated coach to support your ongoing growth. title: Patient Affairs Manager | Global Pharma Company | Melbourne Based
description: This global pharmaceutical company is committed to putting patients and innovation at the heart of everything they do. With a strong focus on improving patient outcomes, they are continuing to build a culture where the patient voice is meaningfully integrated into how the organisation operates.     This is an exciting opportunity to join the Patient Affairs function and play a key role in developing and delivering the local Patient Affairs strategy. You will build trusted, ethical partnerships with patients, caregivers and patient advocacy organisations.  Working across Medical, Market Access, Commercial, and Corporate functions, you will have the opportunity to influence strategy, champion patient perspectives and drive meaningful patient-focused initiatives.      Your Responsibilities Will Include       Developing and maintaining long-term, ethical and compliant relationships with patients, caregivers and patient advocacy organisations  Facilitating patient advisory boards, co-creation workshops, listening programs and other engagement initiatives  Developing and implementing the local Patient Affairs strategy in alignment with regional and global priorities  Leading patient-focused projects that address identified patient needs and measuring their impact  Partnering with patient groups to identify opportunities for collaboration across relevant therapeutic areas  Supporting the development of a strong patient-centric culture across the organisation  Ensuring all patient engagement activities are conducted in line with company policies and the Medicines Australia Code of Conduct       The successful candidate will have:       Experience within the pharmaceutical industry, patient organisations, Patient Affairs, Patient Advocacy or a closely related function  Demonstrated experience working directly with patients and/or patient advocacy organisations  Strong stakeholder management, influencing and networking skills  High emotional intelligence and genuine empathy for patients and caregivers  Strong project management skills with the ability to take initiatives from strategy through to execution  Medicines Australia Code of Conduct CEP certification      Most importantly, you will be passionate about putting the patient voice at the centre of healthcare. This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional pharmaceutical functions and directly influence how patient needs, lived experiences and insights shape strategy and decision-making across the organisation.     You will join a collaborative environment where your ability to build trusted relationships, influence stakeholders and turn patient insights into meaningful action will have a genuine impact on patients and their families.     To apply for this role, please submit your application in WORD format by clicking ‘apply’; or contact  Krista Midri  on  0447 273 551  for further queries. Confidentiality is assured.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description: Inspiroz is seeking a dedicated, detail-oriented Service Delivery Manager (SDM) to join our service delivery management team. As an SDM, you will play a crucial role in leading and ensuring the successful delivery of our IT services to our schools and corporate clients. Working under the supervision of our Director of Service Delivery, you will interact regularly with our remote technical support team, on-site technicians, and various key client contacts.  This role requires travel within territory 35% of the time.      If you have a deep understanding of IT services, a passion for education and technology, and proven experience in client relationship management and team leadership, take the next step in your career, and apply today!     ACS, parent to Inspiroz, has been providing IT services and consulting for 30 years with great success. Principal offerings today include providing strategic advice, IT infrastructure services, and affordable, fully-staffed 24/7/365 IT support and remote monitoring services. ACS started working with schools in 2012 when KIPP Philadelphia became our first school partner. In 2016, we created Inspiroz to fully focus our work on K-12 education. Inspiroz is unique in that we focus our work on charter schools, and we understand what is needed to create and maintain an IT environment that allows teachers and leaders to drive student outcomes and operational excellence.     Inspired by our core values of: Be Courageous, The Extra Mile, Today, Not Tomorrow, and Communicate, Communicate, Communicate we excel in serving our partners and adapting to their ever-changing technology needs.      Key Responsibilities:     Client Relationship Management  Participate in client meetings to review service status, onsite priorities, open tickets, and escalations  Act as the primary service owner for assigned clients, ensuring issues are driven to resolution with the appropriate teams.  Serve as an escalation coordination point—understand issues, assign next steps, and ensure timely follow-up and communication (not expected to personally resolve technical issues).  Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders and manage expectations effectively.  Regular onsite client visits to engage with stakeholders, support the field and remote team, and ensure service quality and alignment with client expectations  Team Management and Development  Lead and manage School Technology Specialists (STS) and Business Technology Specialists (BTS) across assigned client sites.  Provide high-quality customer service and support through strong team coaching, accountability, and performance management.  Conduct regular 1:1 meetings to review performance, priorities, and development plans; coach through technical, process, and people challenges.  Conduct onsite observations and ride-alongs to assess team execution, professionalism, and technical competency.  Train and enforce adherence to daily/weekly checklists, documentation standards

title: Information Technology Operations Manager
description: In de rol van IT Operations Manager, maak je deel uit van het managementteam. Het team is inhoudelijk sterk, klantgericht en werkt binnen een complexe, Microsoft-gebaseerde IT-omgeving.      Jouw verantwoordelijkheden ;   Je geeft dagelijks leiding aan het team en ontwikkelt het team verder op het gebied van professionaliteit, samenwerking en eigenaarschap.  Je bent verantwoordelijk voor klanttevredenheid, kwaliteit van de dienstverlening en het behalen van gemaakte SLA-afspraken.  Je bewaakt daarnaast de financiële prestaties van de klantcontracten.  Je begeleidt veranderingen binnen de teamstructuur en zorgt voor een zorgvuldige overgang voor zowel klanten als medewerkers.  Je brengt structuur en focus in de dagelijkse operatie en bewaakt de balans tussen ad-hoc klantvragen en planmatig werken.  Je stuurt actief op continue verbetering van processen, kwaliteit en efficiëntie.  Je coacht servicemanagers en engineers in hun klantgerichte rol en helpt hen groeien in adviseren, communiceren en eigenaarschap.  Je bent gesprekspartner voor belangrijke klanten en neemt regelmatig deel aan klantgesprekken.  Je initieert en begeleidt verander- en verbeterinitiatieven binnen het team en werkt daarbij nauw samen met verschillende interne specialisten.  Je werkt nauw samen met andere operationeel managers en zorgt voor een goede verbinding tussen klant, team en organisatie.  Je bent zichtbaar en benaderbaar voor medewerkers, zowel op kantoor als op afstand.       We zijn op zoek naar iemand met;    Minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau.  Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als IT operations manager binnen een MSP;  Ervaring binnen IT-dienstverlening en/of managed services.  Ervaring met projectmatig werken, procesverbetering en verandermanagement.       Persoonlijkheid;     Je bent een stevige en ervaren people manager die duidelijk richting geeft.  Je wordt door teams gezien als een natuurlijke en betrouwbare leidinggevende.  Je weet mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen, spreekt medewerkers aan op verantwoordelijkheden en resultaten.  Je combineert aandacht voor medewerkers met een sterke focus op klanttevredenheid en bedrijfsresultaat.  Je bent in staat om operationele vraagstukken te vertalen naar structurele verbeteringen.  Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en schakelt gemakkelijk op verschillende niveaus.  Je bent proactief, besluitvaardig en hebt een sterk gevoel voor eigenaarschap.  Je voelt je prettig in een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is en weet juist in een veranderende omgeving structuur en richting te bieden.

title: Customer Success Specialist (m/w/d) - Jobbird.com
description: Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen sind wir in 19 Ländern tätig und beschäftigen fast 9.000 engagierte Mitarbeitende. Du wirst in einem dynamischen und innovativen Umfeld arbeiten, das voller Möglichkeiten steckt. Mit Deinem Einsatz und Deiner Leidenschaft hast Du die Gelegenheit, einen nachhaltigen Unterschied zu machen.  Gemeinsam gestalten wir das Gesundheitssystem der Zukunft. title: Customer Experience Specialist (m/w/d)
description: Über uns    Richte dich neu aus. Auf deine Zukunft. Mit velpTEC.   velpTEC ist ein auf innovative Technologien ausgerichtetes Weiterbildungsinstitut, das Erfahrungen aus Wirtschaft, Zukunftsforschung und neuen Bildungsansätzen verbindet. Wir unterstützen Menschen durch unsere Bildungsangebote praxisnah dabei, ihre Fähigkeiten für künftige Zeiten zu stärken und damit aktiv ihren Lebensweg zu gestalten. In unserem Handeln legen wir Wert auf gesellschaftliche Verantwortung, Fortschritt und Selbstbestimmung.  Bereit für eine neue Mission? Dann entdecke jetzt deine Zukunftsperspektive bei velpTEC und werde Teil unseres multiprofessionellen und diversen Teams als Customer Experience Specialist (m/w/d).   Was deine Aufgaben sein werden   Customer Experience ist für uns mehr als guter Support – sie entscheidet darüber, wie unsere Kunden, Kundinnen und Teilnehmenden uns erleben und damit auch über unseren langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg. Dabei wollen wir nicht erst dann für unsere Kunden da sein, wenn ein konkretes Anliegen oder Problem entsteht. Gute Customer Experience bedeutet für uns auch, aktiv den Kontakt zu halten, nachzufragen, wie es läuft und frühzeitig zu erkennen, wo wir unterstützen können.  Standardanfragen automatisieren wir. Du kommst dort ins Spiel, wo es Menschen braucht: Wenn persönliche Betreuung gefragt ist, wenn Situationen individuell sind, Zusammenhänge verstanden, Entscheidungen getroffen und Lösungen gefunden werden müssen, die in keinen Standardprozess passen. Deshalb ist das hier keine klassische First-Level-Support- oder Call-Center-Rolle. Wir suchen eine Person, die nicht einfach Tickets abarbeitet, sondern Beziehungen aufbaut, aktiv auf Kunden zugeht, zuhört, mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Dinge wirklich zu Ende bringt. Eine Person, die auch dann eine gute Lösung findet, wenn sie noch in keinem Handbuch steht.    Du begleitest Kunden, Kundinnen und Teilnehmende vor, während und nach unseren Weiterbildungen und bist Ansprechpartner für anspruchsvolle Anliegen.  Du übernimmst die organisatorische und administrative Betreuung und sorgst dafür, dass Vorgänge zuverlässig abgeschlossen werden.  Du koordinierst bei Bedarf mit anderen Teams und behältst auch bei komplexeren Situationen den Überblick.  Du erkennst wiederkehrende Probleme und hilfst uns, Prozesse, Customer Experience und Automatisierungen kontinuierlich zu verbessern. C2-Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse  Sehr gute Kommunikation und ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Menschen und Kundensituationen  Lösungsorientiertes Denken und die Fähigkeit, eigenständig Entscheidungen zu treffen  Organisationstalent, Verbindlichkeit und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise  Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Dinge wirklich zu En

title: Customer Success Specialist
description: Datakeeper is dé innovatieve startup op het gebied van ID wallets. We maken het voor consumenten makkelijk en veilig om hun persoonlijke data te delen met bedrijven. Bij ons staat vertrouwen centraal: wij geloven dat je belangrijke persoonlijke gegevens kunt delen zonder je privacy op het spel te zetten.      Wat ga je doen?   We zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste Customer Success Specialist om ons team te versterken. Jij bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten en zorgt ervoor dat zij Datakeeper goed kunnen gebruiken. Je begeleidt nieuwe klanten bij de implementatie, ondersteunt bestaande klanten bij functionele en inhoudelijke vragen en houdt goed in de gaten wat er bij onze klanten speelt. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met onze accountmanagers en andere collega’s binnen Datakeeper.   Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten en business partners en helpt hen met functionele vragen over onze dienstverlening.  Je begeleidt nieuwe klanten bij de implementatie van Datakeeper en zorgt voor een goede onboarding en training.  Je ondersteunt bestaande klanten bij het gebruik van Datakeeper en helpt hen om onze dienstverlening optimaal in te zetten.  Je onderhoudt actief contact met onze klanten, signaleert vragen, behoeften en knelpunten en zorgt voor de juiste opvolging.  Je signaleert commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en bespreekt deze met de verantwoordelijke accountmanager.  Je ondersteunt onze accountmanagers bij commerciële en operationele werkzaamheden rondom bestaande en nieuwe accounts.       Wat bieden we jou?    Een afwisselende en zelfstandige rol binnen een groeiende scale-up.  Een collegiaal team met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng.  Een goed salaris, 27 vakantiedagen en een Personal Benefit Budget 8%.  Flexibele werktijden waarbij je afwisselt tussen werken op kantoor en thuis.  Macbook en Iphone.  Persoonlijke groei- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden.       Wat breng je mee?    HBO werk- en denkniveau; bij voorkeur een commercieel-economische opleiding.  1 tot 2 jaar ervaring in een klantgerichte en/of commerciële functie.  Je maakt je nieuwe systemen en processen snel eigen en vindt het leuk om inhoudelijk uit te zoeken hoe iets werkt, zodat je klanten zelfstandig verder kunt helpen.  Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.  Goed organisatorisch vermogen en oog voor detail. Een stapje extra willen zetten voor de klant.       Solliciteren?   Is deze functie jou op het lijf geschreven? Solliciteer dan via onderstaand formulier.  Als je nog vragen hebt kan je mailen naar patricia@datakeeper.nl.

title: Customer Success Lead - Western Europe
description: About ElevenLabs   ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.  We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.   We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms     ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.  ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.  ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.    Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.  How we work    High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.  Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.  AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.  Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.  Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. title: Vice President, Customer Success & Enablement
description: Your Impact   The Vice President of Customer Success & Enablement leads DISCO's Customer Success organization, setting the strategy, programs, standards, and operating cadence for how the team drives client value and consumption growth. They manage the CS leadership team and, through them, the broader CSM organization to oversee account planning, performance management, and professional development across the team. They also own the enablement function which includes client training, playbooks, and adoption programs. They must partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Finance to ensure Customer Success operates as a reliable, high-performing part of the company's go-to-market organization.   What You'll Do     Drive Customer Value Realization: Builds and scales department-wide programs that help clients realize the full value of DISCO through proactive engagement, driving the adoption of strategic product capabilities, and other value-driving initiatives tailored to each account. Own the frameworks, playbooks, and execution standards to deliver these items. Report consistently to executive leadership and use the department’s KPIs to guide priorities, resourcing decisions, and performance management.  Lead the Client Advisory Board: Partners with Marketing and Product to lead the Client Advisory Board, developing content and a strategy to simultaneously drive business objectives and deliver a genuinely high-value participant experience.  Own CS Technology & AI Strategy: Sets and executes the department's technology strategy, with a focus on using technology and AI to drive efficiency without degrading the quality of the client experience. Defines adoption standards across the team and holds the department accountable to measurable ROI on its technology investments.  Evolve Client Enablement Programs: Drives continuous evolution of the Enablement function, including new client-facing programs and training strategies that help customers understand how to use DISCO's products and realize full value from AI features. Ensures enablement content and delivery keep pace with new product releases and evolving client needs.  Cross-Functional GTM Point of Contact: Represents Customer Success for client-impacting and go-to-market initiatives spanning Marketing, Sales, Product, and Professional Services. Acts as a genuine strategic partner in cross-functional planning and decision-making, ensuring client context and CS's perspective shape outcomes rather than simply executing decisions made elsewhere.     Who You Are     7+ years of total Customer Success or related experience (account management, customer-facing SaaS roles)  5+ years of people management experience  2+ years of experience managing managers and directors  Consumption-based revenue models: Fluency in how usage/consumption-based (vs. subscription/renewal-based) revenue works, including how to build and interpret metrics that isolate a CS organization's contribution to growth

title: Head of Customer Success
description: The Role (also the Mission)   Today we have sold roughly 200,000 devices to over 200 health systems in 48 states. We are looking for our first permanent Head of Customer Success to lead the function so that it can support over 1 million devices installed  You will lead four functions - Technical Operations (project management, field services, on-site support and maintenance, recertification projects), Customer Success Management, Customer Support, and Customer Education & Enablement - and you will be driving the client health score: devices delivered, devices installed correctly, devices in compliance, customer satisfaction, and renewals.  This role reports to the VP of Operations, who holds the function on an interim basis today.   Here are some ways you'll make an impact (also Outcomes of the role)     In short, you will lead the organization, own the customer journey, scale delivery and installation, and refine and run the operating system  Own the client health score end to end - devices delivered, installed correctly, in compliance, CSAT across all Hexmodal’s  Lead and grow the four functions of Customer Success, and hire, level, and coach the people in them  Own the customer journey - from purchase to renewal  Set new standards, SLAs and success metrics for the teams running these functions, such as cutting Time to Value, or improving CSAT  Keep annual churn low while the installed base grows several times over  Partner with BizOps to build tooling, automation, and AI workflows to scale Support and how your teams serve customers  Stand up Customer Education & Enablement as a function  What success looks like in 12 months   The function runs on scalable systems  Installations are growing in pace with sales and customer and device issues are steadily declining against the baseline  Backlog of non-installed and non-delivered devices has shrunk to near zero  Churn stays at the historically low levels, and every expansion signal reaches Sales  The organization is designed and staffed, and the company trusts your numbers     Competencies we are looking for in the right candidate     10+ years in customer success, post-sales operations, implementation, or service delivery, with 4+ years leading leaders  You have built a post-sales function, not only run one someone else built. You can walk us through what existed on day one and what existed a year later.   You have been part of both rapidly scaling startups and large organizations  You have participated in a high growth, scaling post-sales organization through an order-of-magnitude increase in volume, and can name the constraint your team broke  Physical deployment experience: hardware and software together, devices that ship, get installed, and must stay online and in compliance  Player-coach and ops-heavy  You refine metrics based on data that don’t have enough history to be proven- health scores, time to value, service levels, per-role KPIs, and then hold a team to them without break

title: SVP, Customer Success & Professional Services
description: About The Role   We are looking for a SVP, Customer Success & Professional Services to lead and own Cloudinary’s Enterprise Customer Journey, ensuring enterprise customers realize measurable business value throughout their lifecycle with Cloudinary.  Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, you will own the strategy, operating model, and execution of the enterprise customer journey, from onboarding and implementation through adoption, value realization, and expansion. Your mission is to help customers maximize the value of their investment while building a scalable organization that drives retention, growth, and long-term loyalty.  As a member of the Customer Success leadership team, you will lead a team of CSM’s, who are customer-obsessed and respected by their customers, partner closely with Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Executive Leadership to create seamless customer experiences, accelerate time-to-value, and establish Cloudinary as a strategic partner for our enterprise customers.  This role is ideal for a customer-obsessed executive who combines strategic thinking, operational excellence, commercial acumen, and organizational leadership to build world-class customer experiences at scale.   Responsibilities     Define and execute Cloudinary’s customer journey strategy, driving customer adoption, retention, expansion, and long-term customer value.   Lead and scale high-performing global Customer Success Managementת Professional Services and Customer Education organizations across multiple regions, developing leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer advocacy.   Design and optimize customer lifecycle programs, including onboarding, implementation, adoption, success planning, renewal readiness, and value realization.   Drive operational excellence through customer segmentation, health scoring, lifecycle automation, AI-enabled engagement, customer analytics, and standardized operating models. Du får ansvaret for at navigere gennem den travle sommersæson med et smil og en rolig hånd, hvor du i vintermånederne har et større fokus på strategiske udviklingsprojekter.     Din mission er at sikre Danmarks bedste oplevelse til gæster og husejere gennem lokal tilstedeværelse og evnen til at imødekomme individuelle behov. Din væsentligste opgave bliver sammen med salgschefen at gå forrest, når budget og målsætninger skal indfries. Du bliver en nøglefigur i Feriepartners fremtidige udvikling, hvor der er store ambitioner både lokalt og på landsplan. Din stemme er vigtig for hele kæden, og du vil være med til at præge både lokale initiativer og samarbejdet på tværs af de mange selvstændige bureauer i hele landet. Du bliver det lokale ansigt for Feriepartner Fanø, hvor du aktivt deltager i dialogen med lokale samarbejdspartnere og bidrager til et stærkt lokalsamfund. title: Apulaismyymäläpäällikkö Vaasan myymäläämme
description: Etsimme Vaasan Normal-myymäläämme iloisen ja energisen asenteen omaavaa apulaismyymäläpäällikköä!   Apulaismyymäläpäällikkönä olet avainasemassa luomassa asiakkaille uniikkia osto- ja asiakaskokemusta. Toimit myymäläpäällikön kanssa tiiminä, motivoiden ja kehittäen työntekijöitä avoimessa ja iloisessa ympäristössä. Yhdessä varmistatte, että myymälä toimii tehokkaasti ja saavuttaa myyntitavoitteet. Myymälän visuaalinen ilme ja tiimin johtaminen ovat intohimosi. Pääset perehtymään tehtävääsi huippuosaajien kanssa, jonka tavoitteena on antaa sinulle alkustartti ammatilliseen ja henkilökohtaiseen kasvuun ja kehittymiseen. Kenties mielenkiintosi on toimia jonakin päivänä NORMAL-ketjun myymäläpäällikkönä!  NORMAL on nuori dynaaminen yritys, joka on muutaman vuoden aikana avannut satoja myymälöitä ympäri Euroopan. Myös Suomessa kasvumme jatkuu edelleen.  Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme pysyvästi matalat hinnat ja useita tuhansia ”normaaleja” tuotteita mm. kemikalio-, kosmetiikka- ja kotitaloustuotteiden saralla, unohtamatta jännittäviä uutuuksia joka viikko useissa eri tuotekategorioissa. NORMAL on yritys, jossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia ja meillä on yhteiset menestymis- ja tulostavoitteet - ja samalla pidämme hauskaa yhdessä.   Mitä Toivomme Sinulta     olet kunnianhimoinen ja kerännyt kokemusta esihenkilönä toimimisesta - tuemme sinua roolissasi  asiakaspalvelu on intohimosi – asiakas on aina tärkein  olet motivoitunut, määrätietoinen ja väsymätön tiiminjohtaja – innostat ja motivoit omalla esimerkilläsi  paineensietokykyä – nopeatempoinen työ vie sinut mennessään ja uppoudut siihen mielelläsi  myymälän johtaminen ja kauppiashenkinen toiminen saa sinun syttymään – lukujen seuraaminen tukee myyntiä  omaat itsenäiset työskentelytaidot, mutta ymmärrät tiimin voiman – yhdessä on hauskempaa  sinulla on visuaalista silmää – esillepanojen teko best!  työt sijoittuvat niin aamu-, ilta- kuin välivuoroihinkin – monipuoliset työajat  kommunikoit vaivattomasti suomeksi ja asiakkaiden palvelu englanniksi onnistuu myös - but of course!  myymäläpäällikön ollessa poissa hyppäät puikkoihin empimättä ja varmistat myymäläntoiminnan     Mikäli etsit inspiroivaa, hauskaa ja menevää työpaikkaa, hae ihmeessä meille ja tule osaksi mahtavaa porukkaamme!  Maksamme palkkaa TES:in mukaisesti.   Oletko se sinä?   Odotamme innolla hakemustasi ja arvostamme myös videon muodossa tulevaa esittelyä! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo ennen hakuajan umpeutumista, ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Excellent communication, interpersonal, coordination, and problem-solving skills.   Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and property/tenant management systems.   Strong customer-service orientation and ability to work with a diverse tenant population.

description: Job title:  Senior Service Manager – Run & Maintain | Doha, Qatar      The role   A government ministry in Qatar is building a national digital platform. It brings services from many government and private-sector organisations into one place for citizens. Once it goes live, someone has to make sure it keeps working.  You will be the first hire in the programme's service management function. Your first job is to settle who is responsible for each part of the platform: infrastructure, application updates, the API gateway, identity and login, and the connections to each organisation. Some of these are currently unassigned or only assumed. You then design the service levels, on-call rota, incident escalation and tooling around that ownership.  You also run it. title: Avdelingsdirektør for Brukertjenester i divisjon Trafikant og kjøretøy

company_normalized: statens vegvesen - norwegian public roads administration
description: Om Statens vegvesen  Statens vegvesen er hjertet i Norges veisektor, og vi jobber hver dag for å sikre et effektivt, trygt og helhetlig transportsystem. Som den største aktøren innen veitransport i Norge, har vi ansvaret for riks- og europaveiene, samt sikkerheten til alle som ferdes langs veien. Vårt oppdrag er å planlegge, bygge, drifte og vedlikeholde denne kritiske infrastrukturen.  Vi utvikler regelverk og standarder som gjelder for alle veieiere i Norge, og gjennom vårt arbeid med trafikanter og kjøretøy, ny teknologi og digitale tjenester, sørger vi for at både folk og næringsliv har tilgang til enkle, effektive, trygge og miljøvennlige transportmuligheter.  Statens vegvesen består av to forvaltningsnivåer - et direktorat og seks landsdekkende divisjoner, som sammen jobber for å gjøre veiene våre bedre for alle.  Divisjon Trafikant og kjøretøy (TK) har ansvar for det meste av det som har med førerkort og kjøretøy å gjøre i dette landet. Vi utvikler regelverket innen våre fagfelt og kontrollerer at dette blir fulgt av trafikanter, bileiere, verksteder, trafikkskoler og transportbedrifter. Vi har rundt 1400 ansatte over hele landet og møter publikum hver dag, både fysisk, i telefonen og digitalt. Våre digitale selvbetjeningsløsninger gjør at vi er tilgjengelig hele tiden.  Vi jobber hver dag for at ingen skal bli drept eller hardt skadd i trafikken.  Om stillingen  Vil du lede og utvikle en avdeling med kontakt med innbyggere og næringsliv hver dag? Som avdelingsdirektør for Brukertjenester får du ansvar for en landsdekkende avdeling med 300 ansatte fordelt på 72 trafikkstasjoner.  Avdelingen hjelper kundene våre med spørsmål om førerkort og kjøretøy på trafikkstasjonene og via telefon, e-post og chat. Dette krever god dialog med avdelingene som har ansvar for regelverket på disse områdene.  Du har ansvar for å organisere arbeidet slik at avdelingen møter kundenes behov på en effektiv måte, og for å sikre at medarbeiderne har kompetansen de trenger. Brukertjenester er ofte folks første møte med Statens vegvesen, og har derfor en viktig rolle som vårt ansikt utad. I 2024 fikk vi prisen for beste offentlige kundeservice. For å videreutvikle og profesjonalisere tjenestene våre må du bruke innsikt om blant annet kundehenvendelser, tidsbruk og hvordan oppgavene blir løst.  Statens vegvesen tilbyr stadig flere digitale tjenester, og Brukertjenester har en sentral rolle i å veilede både privatpersoner og profesjonelle kunder, særlig innen kjøretøyområdet. description: About the Job   PhyxUp Health is looking for a Business Operations Manager to help manage and improve our day-to-day business operations across Korea and the U.S.     PhyxUp Health is a San Francisco–headquartered AI healthtech startup building an AI-powered patient care and reimbursement platform for rehabilitation providers in the U.S. Our Korea team works closely with our U.S. operations to build and scale the product.     We are already working with hospitals and clinics across the U.S., and our ARR has grown more than 10x over the past 12 months.      About PhyxUp Health   We believe some of the most important parts of healthcare happen between visits.     Patients spend far more time at home than they do in the clinic, but providers have limited visibility into what happens after the patient leaves. At the same time, clinicians spend significant time on documentation, administrative work, and reimbursement.     PhyxUp uses AI to connect the clinical visit with ongoing care.
