title: HR Supervisor
description: We are seeking an HR Supervisor to serve as the company's sole human resources professional, with responsibility for the full employee lifecycle from recruitment and onboarding through compliance, payroll inputs, employee relations, and exit.  The company employs a large, predominantly expatriate workforce of tradesmen and technicians alongside engineers and administrative staff, so the role requires strong, hands-on command of Saudi labour law, government platforms, work permit and residency processes, and Saudization requirements — including both Nitaqat and the engineering-profession Saudization ratio.  This is an operational, self-directed role suited to a professional who has run HR in a contracting environment rather than administered it in a large corporate function.       Key Accountabilities     Recruitment & Onboarding  Manage recruitment for all levels, from tradesmen and foremen to engineers and administrative staff. Coordinate overseas recruitment of tradesmen, including visa issuance, recruitment agency management, and arrival processing. Screen, shortlist, and coordinate interviews; prepare offer letters within approved budgets. Deliver structured onboarding, including contracts, medical insurance enrolment, and site safety induction.   Government Platforms & Compliance  Manage all transactions on Qiwa, Muqeem, GOSI, Mudad, and related government platforms. Ensure employment contracts are documented and authenticated on the relevant platforms. Track and renew residency permits, work permits, and medical insurance before expiry; process exit/re-entry and final exit visas. Ensure every employee is registered in GOSI under an accurate occupational title and wage.   Saudization Management  Monitor the Nitaqat band continuously and forecast the impact of every hire and exit before it occurs. Monitor the engineering-profession Saudization ratio; verify that each Saudi engineer meets the minimum registered wage and holds professional accreditation. Advise management on hiring sequence to avoid band deterioration during transitions. Identify and apply for available government employment support programmes.   Payroll Inputs & Employee Records  Prepare monthly payroll inputs covering attendance, overtime, leave, deductions, and new joiners and leavers. Maintain complete personnel files, both physical and digital, for all employees. Calculate end-of-service settlements, leave balances, and ticket entitlements in line with labour law and company policy.   Employee Relations & Discipline  Administer disciplinary procedures and grievance handling in accordance with Saudi labour law and company regulations. Represent the company in labour disputes and coordinate with legal advisors where needed. Monitor labour accommodation standards and address welfare issues affecting the trade workforce.    Policies, Performance & Development  Draft and maintain HR policies, including leave, overtime, attendance, and disciplinary rules.

title: IT-Allrounder (m/w/d) als Administrator für die Schul-IT
description:
Die Freie Aktive Schulen Wülfrath gGmbH bietet seit 2005 in Wülfrath im Kreis Mettmann mit ihren drei Bildungseinrichtungen, der „Freie Aktive Kita“, der „Freie Aktive Grundschule“ und der „Freie Aktive Gesamtschule“, für aktuell ca. 380 Kinder im Alter von 2 bis 19 Jahren mit und ohne Förderbedarf die Möglichkeit einer individuellen Förderung nach den Grundsätzen der Montessori-Pädagogik.

Die Freie Aktive Schulen Wülfrath beschäftigen aktuell ca. 100 Mitarbeiter*innen, die in den pädagogischen Teams und den Serviceabteilungen arbeiten. Als Bildungseinrichtung und als Arbeitgeber legen wir viel Wert auf einen gleichwürdigen und achtsamen Umgang auf Augenhöhe mit flachen Hierarchien. Dabei sind für uns Selbstständigkeit und persönliche Verantwortung zentrale Entwicklungsziele.

Aufgaben

  • Betreuung und Verwaltung unserer gesamten IT-Ausstattung (Netzwerk, Server, Clients)
  • Selbstständige Erarbeitung von Lösungen im IT-Umfeld
  • Unterstützung der Mitarbeiter*innen in IT-Fragen zu Soft- und Hardware
  • Analyse und Beseitigung von Störungen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Schüler*innen und Pädagog*innen an verschiedenen Projekten

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung zur/zum Fachinformatiker/in für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Idealerweise Organisationsgeschick mit Gestaltungswillen für die IT Umgebung und Prozesse
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse zu Windows Arbeitsplatz- (PCs, Notebooks, Tablet-PCs, Drucker etc.) und Serversystemen (Win 2019 und 2022, Active Directory, Virtualisierung auf Basis von HYPER-V o.ä.)
  • Praktische Kenntnisse im Troubleshooting von Windows Betriebssystemen
  • Idealerweise gute Kenntnisse der Verwaltung und Konfiguration der Business-Umgebung Microsoft Office 365 und Azure
  • Gerne grundlegendes Know-how in der Netzwerktechnik (WAN, VLAN, VPN, etc.)
  • Fließende Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch
  • Überzeugter Teamplayer

title: Brand Strategy Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Das erwartet Dich bei uns

Du willst die Haarwelt nicht nur beobachten, sondern mitgestalten? Du brennst für Hair & Care, für Pflegeprodukte und für das Friseursalon-Business, und Du hast Lust, zwei starke Marken wirklich nach vorne zu bringen?

Als Brand Strategy Manager verantwortest Du die strategische Entwicklung unserer Partnermarken O&M und EVO. Du führst Deine Marken wie Dein eigenes kleines Unternehmen: Du analysierst Märkte, Performance und Daten, erkennst Wachstumschancen und machst daraus konkrete Strategien. Dein Ziel sind steigende Umsätze, begeisterte Kund:innen und Marken, über die man in der Salonwelt spricht.
Dabei übernimmst Du vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung. Das bedeutet Gestaltungsspielraum, sichtbare Ergebnisse und manchmal auch Druck. Genau das motiviert Dich, statt Dich auszubremsen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Brand- und Portfolio-Strategien für O&M und EVO und treibst deren Umsetzung aktiv voran
  • Du analysierst Produkt-, Markt- und Wettbewerbsdaten und leitest daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ab
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Außendienst zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass Deine Strategien im Salon ankommen
  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für interne Teams sowie für unsere externen Partnermarken
  • Du hast Freude daran, auf der „Bühne“ zu stehen und Deine Marken zu repräsentieren und lässt andere an deiner Begeisterung teilhaben
  • Du unterstützt bei Verhandlungen, Pricing, Distributionsvereinbarungen
  • Du verantwortest das Marketingbudget Deiner Marken und entwickelst wirkungsvolle Promotional Activities inklusive Umsetzung mit unseren Töchtergesellschaften

Das bringst Du mit

  • Erste Berufserfahrung in Brand Management, Category Management, Commercial Manage

title: VA (Virtuelle Assistenz) Social Media & Content Manager (w/m/d) - Freelance, 100% Remote
description:
NETSHAKE ist Shopify Premier Partner, TÜV-zertifiziert und seit 26 Jahren im E-Commerce. Mit über 1.600 Projekten gehören wir zu den erfahrensten Shopify-Agenturen im DACH-Raum. Unsere Kunden sind Onlinehändler, für die wir Shops migrieren, skalieren und in KI-Systemen wie ChatGPT und Google AI sichtbar machen (GEO). Wir arbeiten AI-first, mit Standorten in Stuttgart und Dubai und einem remote verteilten Team.

Wir haben sehr zufriedene Händler, Fünf-Sterne-Bewertungen und messbare Ergebnisse. Was uns fehlt, ist jemand, der diese Erfolge täglich in Content übersetzt.

Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn und YouTube. Du produzierst täglich Content, drehst und schneidest Händler-Testimonials und machst die Erfolge von NETSHAKE sichtbar. Eigenständig, ab dem ersten Tag, ohne Freigabeschleifen über die Geschäftsführung.

Aufgaben

  • Du bespielst TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn und YouTube täglich mit mindestens einem Beitrag pro Kanal – ab deinem ersten Arbeitstag.
  • Du bringst unsere bestehenden Kanäle in Ordnung: Profile, Bios, Highlights, Playlists und Alt-Content.
  • Du produzierst Video-Content end-to-end: Konzept, Aufnahme, Schnitt, Untertitel, Veröffentlichung.
  • Du gewinnst Händler-Testimonials selbst: Du identifizierst zufriedene Kunden gemeinsam mit unserem Sales- und Fulfillment-Team, rufst sie an, führst die Aufnahme per Video-Call, schneidest das Material, veröffentlichst es auf YouTube und verteilst es als Shorts auf allen Kanälen.
  • Du machst aus Bewertungen, Ergebnissen und Projekten wiederverwendbare Formate: Karussells, Quote-Cards, Shorts.
  • Du baust und betreibst den AI Twin unseres CEOs Sven-Oliver Stietzel (Stimme, Bild, Sprachstil) und produzierst damit CEO-Content, ohne seine Zeit zu beanspruchen. Wo er persönlich gebraucht wird, bereitest du alles so vor (Skript, Setup, Fragen), dass er in wenigen Minuten liefert.

title: Werkstudent UX/UI Design (m/w/d)
description:
Stell dir vor, es ist dein erster Tag als Werkstudent UX/UI Design (m/w/d) bei ABRIO. Du wirst herzlich von einem dynamischen und engagierten Team empfangen. Dein Onboarding ist perfekt vorbereitet und nach einem ersten gemeinsamen Team-Lunch tauchst du direkt in die faszinierende Welt des E-Commerce ein – innovative und strategische E-Commerce und Digital Marketing Projekte mit führenden Marken aus den Bereichen FMCG, OTC, Fashion und Beauty.

Du hast sofort gemerkt: Hier kannst du viel lernen, etwas bewegen, selbst Strategien entwickeln und Wissen aus dem Studium praktisch anwenden.

ABRIO ist eine der führenden Digital Commerce Beratung mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main. Unser Ziel: Die E-Commerce-Welt unserer Kunden nachhaltig zu verbessern und skalierbare Erfolge zu schaffen. Dabei kombinieren wir modernste Technologien mit innovativen Marketingansätzen und maßgeschneiderten Lösungen.

In deinem Werkstudium wirst du dich vom ersten Tag an einbringen können sowie Trends und Strategien, die unsere Kunden noch erfolgreicher machen, kennenlernen. Klingt spannend? Dann lies weiter – wir suchen genau dich für unser Team!

  • Start: ab Oktober oder flexibel

  • Stundenumfang: mindestens 16 Stunden, idealerweise 20 Stunden


DAS ERWARTET DICH

  • UI Design: Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung des UI-Designs von Online-Shops, Websites

title: Embedded Software Developer Traffic Management Systems (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

We are smartmicro, the leading specialist in high-performance automotive and traffic radar- and radar/camera hybrid sensor technology. We design, develop and manufacture high-tech sensors for autonomous driving, intelligent traffic infrastructure and smart cities. Our mission is to make roads safer, enable autonomous driving in all-weather scenarios, optimize traffic flow for reduced travel times and enable greener, smarter cities.

We are a German company with international presence in the UK and in the US, while we are headquartered in Braunschweig for design, development and production.

We make the future of mobility a reality.

We are looking for an experienced Embedded Software Engineer.

Your Tasks

  • You integrate our inhouse developed modules into the final product firmware
  • You develop new application software and use hardware debuggers to trace down problems
  • In direct contact with the customers you analyze specific technical issues

Your Strengths

  • Completed studies in electrical engineering or software engineering
  • You have professional work experience in C/C++ software development, software testing and software integration, with first experience in Python
  • Software design patterns and software architectures are familiar terms and processes
  • With your outstanding analytical and interpersonal skills, you are a great teammate and a self-starter
  • Your written and verbal communication skills in English and/or German are excellent

What you can expect from us

  • Innovation: latest technology, innovation and rapid development cycles, excellent work- and test equipment
  • Pleasant working environment: informal culture, motivated teams, short communication channels, room for active participation
  • Future-oriented workplace: modern buildings

title: Teamleitung Finanzbuchhaltung (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind der kompetente Problemlöser und zuverlässige Partner für erst klassige und gleichzeitig effiziente Reinigungslösungen für professionelle Anwender. Über 130 Spezialisten unter einem Dach entwickeln, produzieren und vertreiben Reinigungs- und Pflegeprodukte. Am Standort Memmingen werden alle Buzil und Planta Produkte hergestellt, gelagert und kommissioniert. Die Lieferung an Großhändler erfolgt von hier über Speditionen in über 35 Länder. Uns gibt es in der professionellen Gebäudereinigung, der Industrie, Hotellerie und Gastronomie sowie in Alten- und Pflegeeinrichtungen. Im Geschäftsfeld Private Label werden individuelle Kundenwünsche von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Produkt entwickelt und produziert. Neben einer Tochtergesellschaft in Polen und einer Niederlassung in den Vereinigten Arabischen Emiraten gibt es auch Verkaufsbüros in den Balkanstaaten. Das Unternehmen wurde 1907 von Julius Wagner gegründet und ist seitdem im Familienbesitz.

Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Selbstständige Erstellung und Verantwortung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen
  • Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Sachkonten- und Anlagenbuchhaltung
  • Abstimmung und Klärung von Konten
  • Zahlungsverkehr / Kassenführung / Berechtigung zur Anweisung von Zahlungen
  • Forderungsmanagement · Erstellen und Abstimmen steuerlicher Meldungen (Ust.-Voranmeldung / ZM)
  • Reisekostenabrechnung
  • Verantwortung zur Verwaltung aller finanzbuchhalterischer Stammdaten
  • Organisatorische Führung der Abteilung

Ihr Profil:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Bilanzbuchhalter m/w/d
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Handels- und Steuerrecht
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Buchhaltung bzw. im Finanzwesen
  • Fundierte Microsoft Office Kenntnisse sowie im Umgang mit Finanzbuchhaltungssoftware / ERP System
  • Strukturierte, analytische und präzise Arbeitsweise und Zahlenaffinität

Taxfix does not have a dedicated brand owner at group level today. title: Servicetechniker (m/w/d) Wärmepumpen
description:
Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Installationsunterstützung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung von innovativen Wärmepumpen-Systemen bei unseren Kunden

title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

title: Founding Marketing Lead
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

The Opportunity

Lumai is moving from breakthrough optical-compute research to production AI systems. We need an engineer to build the performance and power modelling capability that guides architecture and compiler decisions before silicon exists, helping us turn a working system into a competitive product.

The Role

You will own the performance and power modelling framework that predicts how Lumai’s photonic AI hardware will perform against real inference workloads. Your models will give architecture and compiler teams a shared source of truth for latency, throughput and power across hardware configurations.

The hard part is balancing speed, fidelity and usability: you will model concurrency, event-driven behaviour and compute-block latency at enough detail to support decisions, while keeping simulations fast enough to compare configurations in minutes. You will characterise operator-level workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results so the model stays grounded in evidence.

By month six, you will have established a reliable modelling flow for priority workloads and device configurations, demonstrated a clear path for closing gaps between model and hardware, and made the simulator a tool that architecture and compiler teams use to make decisions. You will report to the Head of Architecture or VP Engineering and may build and lead a small team around this capability.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain a Python-based framework that models hardware and software latency, hardware concurrency and event-driven relationships.

Tasks

title: Enhetschef Kundenhet Hjälpmedelsverksamheterna
description: Hjälpmedelsverksamheterna ansvarar för drift av hjälpmedelsverksamhet för personer med rörelsehinder i södra delen av Stockholms län samt länsövergripande ansvar för personer med behov av förbrukningshjälpmedel i hemmet,  medicinteknisk apparatur i hemmet samt kommunikations-, kognitions-, syn- och hörselhjälpmedel. Genom ett nära och tydligt ledarskap skapar du goda förutsättningar för en god service, hög kvalitet och professionellt bemötande i varje kontakt.    Vi söker dig som trivs i en verksamhet där människor, utveckling och samhällsnytta möts. Du har en god förståelse för patienters behov och perspektiv och vikten av ett professionellt bemötande. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga.    Erfarenhet från hjälpmedelsverksamhet, hälso- och sjukvård eller annan offentlig verksamhet.    Kunskap om förskrivningsprocess och förskrivares förutsättningar.     Personliga egenskaper     Trygg i ditt ledarskap.    Lyhörd och kommunikativ.    Lösningsorienterad, ser möjligheter snarare än hinder.    Du är strukturerad och kan prioritera när det är många frågor samtidigt.    Har ett genuint intresse för service och kvalitet.     Villkor     Du kommer att erbjudas en tillsvidareanställning i grundbefattning med ett treårigt förordnande som enhetschef.    Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver tas i anspråk för intern omplacering, enligt gällande regelverk.     Vid patientnära arbete inom Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde:      - tillämpas registerkontroll före beslut om anställning enligt SLSO:s övergripande anvisning för registerkontroll vid anställning.     - ska medarbetare som kommer att ha patientkontakt genomgå nyanställningsundersökning, enligt gällande direktiv, vilket sker genom företagshälsovården innan anställning.     - krävs, förutom svensk yrkeslegitimation, goda kunskaper i svenska språket motsvarande nivå C1 enligt den gemensamma europeiska referensramen (GERS).  'Orchard' began as the in-house creator programme behind 'In Print We Trust'. That programme took the brand to over a billion views a month and the 13th most-mentioned fashion brand on TikTok UK, and put thousands of creators on contract.

 You MUST be DTC/ecommerce/Meta native.

  Benefits  
 
 £65,000 - £95,000 base + commission

title: Senior Security Assurance Specialist
description:
Location: Office First - Berlin

Team description

Our security assurance team keeps SumUp's information security programme credible, both to regulators and to the millions of merchants who trust us with their business. As part of a small global team spanning Europe, Brazil and Chile, you'll help translate frameworks like ISO 27001, PCI DSS and NIST into practical controls that hold up under real audits and real third-party scrutiny. This is a chance to shape how a fast-growing fintech proves its security maturity across multiple regulatory environments at once, with real ownership over the areas you improve.

What you'll do

  • Review information security controls, audit findings and risk mitigation plans, working with other teams to put the right fixes in place
  • Run third-party due diligence, supplier reviews and contract assessments as part of the third-party risk management process
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to promote strong security practices and help embed security principles into their day-to-day processes
  • Support external and internal audits and due diligence requests, responding directly to auditors, clients and partners
  • Track relevant laws, regulations and security standards, flagging gaps against SumUp's existing controls
  • Help maintain and improve the team's security maturity picture, identifying priority areas and leading or supporting initiatives to close them

You'll be great for this role if...

  • Experience reviewing and improving information security controls in a similar assurance or GRC-focused role
  • Strong knowledge of information security standards such as ISO 27001 and NIST, plus payment security standards like PCI DSS
  • Comfort working with third party risk management and audit procedures, including supplier and contract reviews
  • Ability to prioritise and simplify complex, sometimes ambiguous request

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
Team description

The Central Product Analytics team sits at the heart of how SumUp understands and improves the experience of millions of merchants using our products every day. This role owns the Engagement domain — covering merchant engagement, product activation, support responses, and navigation across the SuperApp and web dashboard — and is the primary analytics partner for the Engagement product team. It's a genuine opportunity to take full ownership of a domain, build the measurement foundations from the ground up, and shift the team from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-led decision-making.

What you'll do

  • Define event taxonomies and measurement plans, implement and QA tracking (GA4), and make sure analytics is built into new product features from day one

  • Build and maintain scalable datasets in Snowflake — including funnels, customer behaviour models, and feature adoption metrics — and use them to generate insights that directly inform product decisions

  • Design and evaluate A/B tests: define success metrics, assess statistical validity, and communicate results clearly to product and engineering stakeholders

  • Create and maintain intuitive dashboards and reusable query templates in Tableau that help teams answer their own questions without always needing an analyst

  • Partner with product managers to develop and map out KPI trees, identify measurement gaps, and improve the quality and accuracy of engagement tracking across the domain

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Proven experience as a Data or Product Analyst, with a strong track record of working with customer behaviour data and translating it into product decisions.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, including writing, optimising, and validating queries, building data models, and participating in code reviews.

Organisation du travail : Hybride – jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail par semaine
Rémunération : 55–85 k€ selon profil
Contrat : CDI

L'entreprise

Pysae est un éditeur de logiciels de 40 personnes qui développe des solutions SaaS pour le secteur du transport public. Notre plateforme couvre le suivi des véhicules en temps réel, l'information voyageurs et la gestion des opérations pour les opérateurs de bus et d'autocars — conçue pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle et s'intégrer en profondeur aux systèmes d'information de nos clients.

Vous êtes également le lien entre toutes les parties lorsque Pysae candidate en tant qu'intégrateur : vous coordonnez partenaires, sous-traitants et maîtres d'œuvre externes pour que chacun livre sa contribution

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.

description: About Mixpanel   Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.   About The Team   Our Renewals team owns the commercial success of Mixpanel's existing customer base, protecting and growing renewable ARR across APAC. We take a proactive, full-lifecycle approach to every account: planning early, leading with the value customers realise from Mixpanel, and building the commercial strategy that turns satisfied customers into long-term, growing partnerships.  This is a highly cross-functional team. We partner closely with Customer Value Architects, Account Executives, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Product to deliver successful customer outcomes and predictable, disciplined revenue retention across the region.   About The Role   As a Renewal Manager, you'll own the commercial success of your book of business, taking a proactive, 12-month approach to renewal planning, customer value, stakeholder alignment, and negotiation. You'll be accountable for the end-to-end renewal lifecycle, from early strategy and stakeholder mapping through negotiation, execution, and post-renewal success planning, always focused on customer satisfaction, long-term retention, and sustainable growth.  A renewal is being managed from the moment the last one is signed. You'll set the strategy long before commercial negotiations begin, protect the commercial baseline in every decision, and maintain a forecast that leadership can trust, with no surprises and no last-minute category flips. You'll lead with value, understand what customers achieved with Mixpanel today, and build your commercial approach around the outcomes we’ve delivered.  This is a commercial, ownership-driven role at the centre of Mixpanel's customer lifecycle in APAC. It's ideal for someone who thrives in multi-stakeholder commercial motions, forecasts with discipline, and wants a visible role in building a high-performing renewals function across the region.   Responsibilities     Own the commercial health of an assigned book of business, maintaining a clear, current view of where your business will land, the key risks and opportunities, and the actions required to hit quarterly and annual targets  Build and maintain a documented renewal strategy for every priority account, aligning with Account Executives and Customer Value Architects on customer priorities, risks, and growth opportunities  Protect the commercial baseline by considering the long-term impact of pricing, concessions, contract changes, and commercial commitments before they are agreed  Lead commercial negotiations with confidence and discipline, developing pricing and packaging strategies aligned to customer value, defending Mixpanel

title: DB Pensions Implementation Manager
description: Description   The  DB Pensions Implementation Manager  plays a central role in transitioning services for new clients into OneDB and delivering impactful projects for our existing client base. This is a varied, hands-on role combining project management and close collaboration across teams.  OneDB, WTW’s blended service proposition for small to medium sized DB pension schemes, represents one of our fastest-growing areas of business in the UK. At its heart OneDB offers a ‘one-stop-shop’ approach to administration, actuarial and investment services underpinned by the latest technology. Such is the success of OneDB that, in the last year, we have won over 13 new appointments.  Sitting within our Retirement business and reporting to a Senior Director, you will be responsible for ensuring all onboarding delivery milestones are met, tracking and reporting on progress in relation to data installation, payroll set up, calculation automation and admin go live readiness. Acting as functional manager for all install team members, you will work closely with our expert sub-teams across Data, Calculations and Transitions, assigning tasks to them and holding them to agreed quality standards and timescales. Whilst the Service Transition Programme Manager is responsible for managing the client relationship throughout the onboarding and early stabilisation stages, you will support them by providing transparent progress updates and supporting with client queries as necessary. You may also be asked to join client meetings from time to time to provide more detailed updates on the transition.  In addition to new client onboards, you may be called upon to manage a range of projects for existing clients, such as GMP equalisation, buy-in/buy-out readiness, benefit rectification, scheme mergers, wind-ups and other pension change initiatives. In doing so, you will coordinate colleagues across multiple lines of business, together with administrators, actuaries and external partners. title: Customer Success Manager – Fidelity Private Shares

title: Account Manager
description: We are recruiting for an established service business looking to appoint an Account Manager to take ownership of an important client relationship and the day-to-day delivery of the service.     This is a highly client-facing role and would suit someone who enjoys building strong relationships, solving problems and taking responsibility for ensuring agreed service levels and performance targets are consistently achieved.     The successful candidate will act as the main point of contact for the client, working closely with the operational team to ensure KPIs, SLAs and service standards are delivered. You will monitor performance, identify issues early and take ownership of resolving them, while continually looking for opportunities to improve service delivery and efficiency.     Key responsibilities will include managing the day-to-day client relationship, monitoring performance against agreed targets and KPIs, supporting and developing the operational team, reviewing performance data and trends, preparing client reports and managing complaints or service issues. You will also work closely with internal teams across finance and operations, with responsibility for contract budgets, cost control and identifying opportunities to develop the account.     We are looking for someone with strong relationship-management skills who is comfortable working in a target-driven environment. You should be commercially aware, confident working with performance data and able to demonstrate initiative and sound judgement when operational issues arise.     You will need to be self-motivated, organised and comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for direction. Previous experience managing people and working within a service-led or B2B environment would be highly advantageous.     The role is based in the Kildare/Newbridge area and will involve travel to client locations and the company’s Dublin office, so a full driving licence is required.     Package: c. €60k fixed package plus discretionary bonus and benefits, including health insurance, pension, laptop, phone and 22 days’ annual leave increasing with service.

title: Palvelupäällikkö, Ajoneuvokorvaukset-yksikkö, LähiTapiola Vakuutusliiketoiminnan palvelut
description: Haluatko olla rakentamassa tulevaisuuden palveluorganisaatiota omistaja-asiakkaidemme elämän turvaamiseksi? Innostaako sinua arvostava ihmisten johtaminen, muutoksen läpivienti ja palveluiden kehittäminen? Tule viemään kanssamme elämänturvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja tekemään merkityksellistä työtä yrityskulttuurissa, jossa tärkein kivijalka on hyvinvoiva ja osaava henkilöstö.       Olemme perustamassa vuoden 2027 alusta uutta tiimiä Vaasaan osaksi Ajoneuvokorvaukset-yksikköämme. Etsimme nyt tiimille suunnannäyttäjäksi osaavaa palvelupäällikköä.       Tehtävä on uusi ja pääset siinä rakentamaan tiimisi osaksi valtakunnallista, kehittyvää ajoneuvokorvausten kokonaisuutta — kokeneen johtotiimin ja kollegajoukon tuella. Palvelupäällikkönä olet paitsi tiimisi korvausneuvojien esihenkilö, myös yksikkömme johtotiimin jäsen. Tärkeimmät tehtäväsi ovat valmentava esihenkilötyö, arjen onnistumisten edellytyksien luominen, palveluidemme kehittäminen sekä paikallisen yhteistyön vieminen seuraavalle tasolle.      Tiimisi korvausneuvojat työskentelevät ajoneuvo- ja venevahinkojen parissa kaikissa palvelukanavissamme. Työskentelemme yksikössämme monipaikkaisesti: osa oman tiimisi korvausneuvojista työskentelee Vaasan lisäksi muilla Länsi-Suomen alueen paikkakunnilla, esimerkiksi Porissa. Lähimmät kollegasi ovat Tampereella, Kuopiossa ja Espoossa.     Sinulle on keskeistä viedä tiimisi kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita omalla esimerkilläsi. Tärkeä tehtäväsi on myös tukea henkilöstömme hyvinvointia, vahvistaa yhtenäisiä toimintamalleja sekä rakentaa myönteistä tekemisen kulttuuria. Olet onnistunut tehtävässä, kun uusi Vaasan tiimimme löytää paikkansa osana valtakunnallista ajoneuvokorvausten kokonaisuutta, arjen johtaminen on selkeää, tiimisi korvausneuvojat onnistuvat tuellasi työssään ja yhteistyömme paikallisen alueyhtiön kanssa on mutkatonta ja sujuvaa.     Yksikön johtotiimin jäsenenä osallistut yksikkömme palveluiden ja prosessien kehittämiseen sekä arvostavan, aktiivisen ja tavoitteellisen johtamiskulttuurin rakentamiseen. Painotamme kykyä ennakoida ja halua toimia muuttuvassa maailmassa sekä innostaa muita mukaan. Kannustamme esihenkilöitä osallistavaan ja valmentavaan johtamiseen     Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää matkustamista ja säännöllistä, viikoittaista läsnäoloa tiimiläistesi työskentelypaikkakunnilla sekä valmiutta liikkua myös yksikkömme muilla sijaintipaikkakunnilla.      Toivomme sinulta    Vankkaa kokemusta valmentavasta ja tuloksellisesta esihenkilötyöstä sekä konkreettisia näyttöjä muutosjohtamisesta asiakaspalveluorganisaatiossa  Innostusta ja kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseen sekä prosessien kehittämiseen  Halua erinomaisen asiakaspalvelun tuottamiseen korvauspalvelussa  Tavoitteellista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työskentelytapaa sekä hyvää paineensietokykyä  Erinomaisia yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä verkostoitumistaitoa  Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista osaamista  Tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa       A

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description: We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Manager – Finland (CRM & Content) to drive user engagement and, most importantly, grow the share of paying subscribers.  This is a highly hands-on role sitting across two equally important areas: CRM & lifecycle marketing and content operations.     On the CRM side, you’ll own the customer journey from single-ticket purchase to subscription, as well as onboarding, engagement and retention. You’ll build and optimise campaigns and automations across email, mobile and onsite channels, with success measured by subscriber growth, conversion and retention – not just opens and clicks. You’ll ensure content moves efficiently from production through adaptation to campaign-ready assets across paid, CRM, social and brand channels.     This is not a purely strategic marketing role. We’re looking for someone who enjoys getting into the tools, building campaigns, managing content, speaking to customers and making things happen.     CRM & Lifecycle Marketing   Build, launch and optimise CRM automations and manual campaigns across email, mobile and onsite messaging.  Own the single-ticket-to-subscriber conversion journey, alongside onboarding and renewal.  Manage weekly and recurring campaigns end-to-end – from copy and design through build, QA and send.  Own segmentation, targeting and campaign optimisation.  Measure performance against subscriber conversion, active subscribers and churn.      Content & Agency Management      Own the end-to-end content pipeline from production agencies through adaptation to channel-ready assets.  Brief, manage and QA external agencies, ensuring quality, consistency and deadlines.  Coordinate assets across paid, CRM, social and brand channels.  Manage timelines, versions and channel-specific requirements.      Creators, Influencers & Social      Source, brief, contract and manage content creators and influencers.  Manage usage rights and ensure creator content can be used across the wider advertising pipeline.  Track performance and use learnings to improve future partnerships.  Own the social content calendar and day-to-day community management.  Monitor and respond to comments and direct messages while actively growing the community. Support the VP with brand campaigns, partnerships, OOH and other above-the-line activity.      You’ll ideally bring:      5+ years of B2C marketing experience, with hands-on CRM/lifecycle ownership.  Experience building automations and campaigns yourself within a modern CRM/marketing automation platform.  A proven track record of using CRM to increase paying customers, subscribers or revenue.  Experience managing external agencies and multi-stage content production workflows.  Experience managing content creators and/or influencer partnerships, including contracting and performance tracking.  Excellent Finnish copywriting

description: Qui sommes-nous ?    Koala Interactive est une société à taille humaine en forte croissance, en charge de Wyylde, le réseau social qui permet d’explorer la diversité des pratiques sexuelles, dans un cadre sécurisé. Chez Koala Interactive, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler dans un environnement qui valorise votre créativité et autonomie, tout en respectant votre équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle grâce au télétravail.    Rôle    Le/la Customer Success Manager est garant.e de la performance et de la conformité de l'ensemble de notre dispositif de support et de modération, en pilotant à la fois les équipes internes et notre prestataire externe.    Ton obsession :  coacher et motiver ton équipe au quotidien afin d'assurer la satisfaction de nos utilisateurs, tout en garantissant que nos processus de modération restent conformes aux exigences réglementaires applicables (règlement sur les services numériques, Arcom).   Tu es également garant.e de l'amélioration continue des processus de traitement des demandes utilisateurs et de modération de contenus.   Last but not least : tu portes la voix du client à travers l'organisation et particulièrement auprès de l'équipe Produit pour intégrer à notre roadmap les demandes et suggestions des utilisateurs.    Missions et Responsabilités       Garantir la qualité du service  fourni par les équipes internes et notre prestataire externe afin de satisfaire nos utilisateurs   Être garant.e de la  conformité juridique  de notre dispositif de modération au regard du règlement sur les services numériques (RSN/DSA) et des exigences de l'Arcom : mise à jour des procédures, traçabilité des décisions, coordination avec la Direction Juridique   Superviser la  chaîne d’escalade des demandes et signalements , notamment les cas complexes, sensibles ou présentant un enjeu juridique, et coordonner si nécessaire les signalements aux autorités compétentes.   Définir, structurer et améliorer en continu les  processus de support et de modération  afin d'accompagner la croissance et le développement international de Wyylde.    Garantir la performance opérationnelle du service client  (délai de première réponse, taux de résolution au premier contact, délai de résolution) dans 6 langues, avec une couverture 24/7   Réaliser des bilans mensuels sur le niveau de qualité de service délivré et animer le comité de pilotage avec notre prestataire   Contribuer au déploiement et à l'atteinte des  objectifs qualité fixés , et assurer le suivi des indicateurs

title: Customer Incident Manager
description: The role & its impact  When incidents happen, every second counts. You'll be the key orchestrator managing major and minor incidents from the customer's perspective—working across teams to find solutions fast and keep everyone informed. You'll balance immediate crisis response with strategic problem-solving, ensuring customers experience minimal disruption and have clarity on what's happening and why.  You'll own incident management end-to-end: from investigation and impact assessment through to post-incident reviews and recommendations that prevent problems from happening again. You'll build the systems and processes that help teams respond confidently and reduce incidents before they occur, making you instrumental in building customer trust.  The team & how they connect  The incident management team works at the heart of Xero's customer operations, coordinating across engineering, product, support, and leadership to respond to issues that affect our customers. They're problem-solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, bringing rigour and human empathy to every incident response. The team collaborates across geographic regions and departments, treating every issue as an opportunity to strengthen Xero's resilience.  The team is currently working on / Initially, the role may focus on    Building and refining incident management processes and incident registers to prevent issues before they occur  Managing customer-facing communications during incidents to keep stakeholders informed and reassured  Coordinating cross-functional teams to implement both short-term fixes and long-term solutions  Post-incident reviews and recommendations that help reduce recurrence    Where and how you can work  This role has a hybrid working arrangement of 3 days working from our offices and 2 days working from home.  Here are some of the things we are looking for    You'll bring strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to make informed decisions and lead teams through high-pressure situations toward resolution.  You'll thrive on building relationships and collaborating effectively—your ability to influence across all levels and challenge assumptions respectfully makes you a natural leader in complex situations.  You'll demonstrate a genuine customer service mentality, ensuring every decision prioritises minimising customer impact and keeping them informed with clarity.  You'll bring proven experience managing major incidents or complex issues, alongside a track record of leading projects to successful delivery outcomes.  You'll Go Together by coordinating specialist teams across regions and bringing the right people to the table to solve problems—comfortable working autonomously but knowing when to collaborate.  You'll Go Fast by ship ideas, test solutions, and improve them—taking initiative and pushing forward in fast-paced, high-profile environments without waiting for perfect clarity.     Apply even if your experience isn't

title: Guest Services Manager
description: Job Title   Guest Service Manager      Role Purpose   Lead Tour Guides, Ushers, Access Control staff and assigned Golf Cart Drivers. Manage resources with financial discipline and provide timely daily and weekly reports. title: Avdelingsleder
description: Som Avdelingsleder Kristiansand får du ansvaret for å lede og videreutvikle en sentral avdeling i et marked med betydelig potensial og strategisk betydning for Cramo. Rollen kombinerer operativ ledelse med et tydelig strategisk ansvar, der du både skal sikre en effektiv daglig drift og bidra til å forme avdelingens videre utvikling og vekst.  Kristiansand er et viktig satsingsområde for Cramo, og som avdelingsleder vil du være tett på beslutningsprosesser som påvirker både den lokale virksomheten og selskapets videre utvikling. Du får totalansvar for avdelingens drift, resultater, medarbeidere, HMS-arbeid og kundeopplevelser, samtidig som du forventes å identifisere nye muligheter og skape langsiktig verdiskaping.  Dette er en rolle for deg som motiveres av å skape resultater gjennom mennesker, bygge sterke relasjoner og utvikle en virksomhet med høye ambisjoner.   Om Stillingen   Ansvarsområder    Lede den daglige driften av avdelingen med ansvar for økonomiske resultater, medarbeidere og HMS.   Sikre høy kundetilfredshet og videreutvikle avdelingens markedsposisjon.   Følge opp budsjetter, KPI-er og gjennomføre nødvendige tiltak for å nå avdelingens mål.   Utvikle og motivere medarbeidere gjennom tydelig ledelse og aktiv oppfølging.   Sikre effektiv ressursutnyttelse og optimalisering av avdelingens maskinpark.  Bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring av arbeidsprosesser, kvalitet og miljøarbeid.   Samarbeide tett med salgsorganisasjonen for å identifisere og realisere vekstmuligheter i markedet.     Hos Cramo får du en sentral lederrolle med stor påvirkningskraft i en virksomhet som skal vokse videre. Du blir en del av et sterkt fagmiljø med korte beslutningsveier og høy grad av tillit og ansvar.  Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, gode utviklingsmuligheter og muligheten til å lede en avdeling som står sentralt i vår videre satsing i Agder. Er du klar for å ta ansvar for videre utvikling av vår virksomhet i Kristiansand? Da ser vi frem til å høre fra deg.  Kombinerer forretningsforståelse med evnen til å skape engasjement og resultater gjennom andre. Banks, fintechs and AI companies use our infrastructure to access the investment, pension, savings, insurance and loan data their customers choose to share, structured and ready to use. Not because they are careless, but because the answer sits scattered across countless institutions that have never had a reason to put it together. Putting it together is what we do.     It is a tougher challenge than it looks from the outside. Financial data is fragmented, unstandardised and locked inside legacy systems that are different in every market we enter. Reaching it reliably, at the standard a bank will actually sign off on, is the hard part. Every customer we take live is one more financial service built on the full picture instead of a piece of it.     We started in Stockholm in 2018 with insurance data. You are the customer's main point of contact from week one until they are live - when things are going well, and when challenges arise. title: Security Delivery Manager
description: Join Accenture Security and play a key role in strengthening our clients’ cyber defense capabilities.  As a  Cybersecurity Service Delivery Manager , you will lead the delivery of SIEM logging and security monitoring enablement across complex enterprise environments. You will combine strong technical knowledge of SIEM and log management with delivery leadership, ensuring security-relevant data is onboarded, normalized and validated to effectively support threat detection and monitoring use cases. What You’ll Do  SIEM & Logging Delivery    Lead end-to-end delivery of log-source assessment, onboarding and validation into enterprise SIEM platforms, with Splunk preferred.   Define and govern logging requirements aligned with security monitoring, detection and investigation use cases.   Oversee log onboarding activities including source identification, ingestion, parsing, field extraction, normalization and validation.   Assess log sources for quality, completeness, consistency and security value, identifying gaps and recommending remediation.   Ensure required security events and fields are captured accurately and made available to monitoring and detection teams. Apply strong knowledge of common logging formats and protocols, including syslog, JSON, Windows Event Logs and application logs.   Drive consistent approaches to data normalization and standardization across diverse technology environments.   Understand how telemetry supports detection engineering and collaborate with detection teams to ensure logs meet defined use-case requirements.   Coordinate dependencies across application, infrastructure, platform and cybersecurity teams to enable required logging.   Lead delivery through batch-based, wave-based or phased onboarding approaches, balancing delivery priorities, dependencies and technical readiness.    Service Management & Governance    Own delivery planning, progress tracking, risks, issues, dependencies and stakeholder reporting for assigned logging initiatives.   Establish clear quality criteria and ensure onboarding outputs meet agreed technical and operational requirements.   Produce high-quality assessments, onboarding documentation, status reporting and management-level updates.   Facilitate working sessions with technical teams and stakeholders to resolve blockers and maintain delivery momentum.   Identify opportunities to improve onboarding processes, logging standards, operational efficiency and monitoring coverage.

VERDANCY
Aachen, Germany (RWTH Aachen) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / AgTech & Biotechnology

**About Verdancy
**Verdancy is a start up in the making from the Schwaneberg Group at the Institute of Biotechnology of RWTH Aachen University. It develops biodegradable additives that make crop-protection products stick to leaves and last longer. Bio-based microgels carry the active substance and release it on demand, while bi-adhesive peptides anchor the microgel to the leaf wax so the coating survives rain — meaning fewer sprays and less pesticide lost to the environment. A second product line uses bifunctional peptides (antimicrobial peptide + anchor) as peptide-based pesticides in their own right, protected by patent EP3261435B1. The entry market is copper fungicide against grapevine downy mildew, where there is no real alternative today, poor rain resistance is a known problem, and the EU is pushing hard to cut copper use.

**The opportunity
**Built on more than 10 years of university research across six projects (€7m raised, TRL 5), the startup is now being further developed by Susanne Braun (CSO, polymer chemist, carrier systems and formulations) and Atul Kumar (CTO, biotechnologist, protein engineering). Verdancy already has a developed business model, funding secured through May 2027 via the Warp Speed Fund of the Materials Lab Incubator (MerLIn), a successful soybean-rust project and a new €2.4m insect-focused project starting January 2027. What's missing is the business development leadership to found the spin-off company and go after an €80B addressable market (€1.2B in the copper segment alone).

title: Senior Analytics Engineer (Multiple Domains)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Analytics at Wolt is a business-critical area that covers three different teams: data science, regional business operations, and analytics engineering. The complexity of online delivery, differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, and vast amounts of data make our work truly interesting!

Now we are looking for three experienced Senior Analytics Engineers to join our Analytics Engineering teams. We have three domains available: Consumer, Merchant, or Ads. You can work in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki.

About the role

The role is focused on the business needs - you'll be working within a cross-functional team, making sure your teammates get the insights needed for their operations. The role requires interpreting the needs and requests of our internal stakeholders from business and product, and transforming them into actionable data. Data Scientists working in the domain will be your closest partners in your day-to-day work, as your solutions will enable them to create relevant experiments, A/B tests, and analyses.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Mercura (YC W25) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes - and eightfolded our revenue in 12 months. With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US.

About the role

You are the second designer here, and you own product surface end to end: you find the problem, decide if it's worth solving, design it, build it, ship it, and then check whether it worked.

That last part is the job. Most designers stop at handoff. You won't have one. You'll sit with a German construction supplier watching them fight a spreadsheet, decide which of their five complaints is the real one, and have something in front of them within days. Then you'll open PostHog to find out if it moved anything.

We ship fast and polished. If those feel like you, this is the right role for you.

What you will be working on

  • Find the real problem. Run your own customer conversations — no PM filter. Distinguish what users ask for from what they need, and be willing to conclude something isn't worth building.

  • Ship it yourself. Design and write the production code. React/TypeScript. You own the result, not a layer of it.

  • Know if it worked. Instrument what you ship. Define the success metric before you build. Kill your own features when the data says so.

description:
About SandboxAQ

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. As a Machine Learning Engineer on AQCell, you will build and maintain the models and data infrastructure that power this pipeline.

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.

You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

About FastSpring:

Payment Operations Specialist, Technical Operations

Department: Payment Operations | Location: Remote — United States | Reports To: Senior Manager, Payment Operations

Position Overview:

The Payment Operations Specialist, Technical Operations supports daily payment operations across multiple processors and regions for FastSpring's network of more than 2,500 sellers. The role pairs hands-on operational work — chargeback and PayPal dispute support, issue investigation, and seller-facing resolution — with technical operations analytics across five areas: authorization rates, chargeback rates, data normalization, processing costs, and reconciliation support. It is an entry-to-early-career position for someone curious about how payments work, comfortable in a spreadsheet, and inclined to chase down a number that looks wrong.

Within a year, this person should own recurring analysis in at least one of those five areas, handle disputes independently, and be the person others ask when a number doesn't reconcile — a path that leads toward senior payment operations, payments analytics, or risk and fraud. Payments is a field you learn by doing, and we welcome candidates from varied backgrounds and career paths; curiosity and analytical instinct matter more here than a specific résumé.

  • Investigate Tier I–II payment inquiries involving authorizations, declines, settlements, refunds, disputes, or processor behavior; escalate complex cases and maintain clear handoff notes, including for weekend coverage.
  • Track authorization approval and decline rates across processors, regions, and payment methods, breaking declines down by response code and category to pinpoint where approvals are being lost.
  • Normalize payment data across sources — processor response codes, decline and chargeback categories, and reporting definitions — and run routine data-quality

description:
ABOUT KOG

Kog builds a co-designed inference stack for real-time AI agents on standard datacenter GPUs, spanning model architecture, inference engine, compilers, and low-level GPU kernels.

On the model side, we developed Laneformer 2B and Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP), a Transformer architecture that overlaps communication with useful computation and weight streaming.

On the systems side, the Kog Inference Engine runs this stack on standard AMD and NVIDIA datacenter GPUs.

Kog generates 3,500 tokens/s per request on 8 AMD MI300X GPUs and 2,100 tokens/s per request on 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, in FP16 at batch size 1, with quantization and speculative decoding disabled.

Our next major project is AGCO, our agentic compiler. AGCO is designed to optimize LLMs across different GPUs and optimization targets, including very fast inference.

The team has 10 people, including 9 engineers and researchers and 4 PhDs.

Test it at playground.kog.ai. Read the technical details on the Kog Labs blog.

You will work directly on AGCO.

The goal is to build a system that can explore ways to optimize LLM execution, generate changes, compile them, check correctness, run them on real hardware, measure the results, and use this feedback to guide the next optimization.

title: Network Operation Engineer
description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. title: Sales Associate in Teilzeit (m/w/x) Frankfurt Airport (20 Stunden)
description:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, die Kunstwelt für alle zu öffnen.

Kunst verändert den Blick auf die Welt. Mit dem Ziel, Kunst zu demokratisieren, hat LUMAS den Kunstmarkt verändert. Unterstützt von 250 Künstlern und einer Community von über 300.000 Kunstliebhabern sind wir heute der globale Marktführer für Kunsteditionen. 
Wir laden Dich ein, Deine Karriereziele mit uns zu teilen. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Persönlichkeiten, die unser Team mit neuen Ideen und Fähigkeiten bereichern. Lass uns gemeinsam die Verbindung zwischen Kunst und Einzelhandel revolutionieren und so Alltag und Kunst zusammenbringen.

Diese Galerie befindet sich im Terminal 3 des Frankfurter Flughafens und die Arbeitszeiten werden sich nach unseren Öffnungszeiten von 06:00 bis 21:30 Uhr richten.


Deine Aufgaben

Als Sales Associate spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Team, indem du aktiv das Kauferlebnis unserer Kunden mitgestaltest. Bringe dein Interesse für Kunst ein und unterstütze uns bei täglichen Aufgaben sowie besonderen Events. 

  • Beratung und Verkauf unserer Kunstwerke mit einer persönlichen Note 
  • Sicherstellung eines unvergesslichen Besuchs- und Kauferlebnisses 
  • Unterstützung bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Galerie-Events 
  • Vielfältige Aufgaben von der Kundenbetreuung bis zum Management des Lagerbestands 


Dein Profil

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Einzelhandel oder einem serviceorientierten Bereich sind von Vorteil 
  • Ein kommunikatives, kundenorientiertes Naturell 
  • Fähigkeit, administrative Aufgaben effizient und strukturiert zu bewältigen 
  • Sehr gute Deut

title: Werkstudent Social Media Marketing & Content Management Wirtschafts- und Finanzbildung (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns

Die gemeinnützige Flossbach von Storch Stiftung engagiert sich mit Passion für die Förderung von Wirtschafts- und Finanzbildung. Ziel ist es, möglichst vielen ein selbstbestimmtes und finanziell unabhängiges Leben zu ermöglichen. Gleichzeitig hilft Wirtschafts- und Finanzbildung, gesellschaftliche und politische Entwicklungen zu verstehen. So stärkt sie die Menschen, die Gesellschaft und die Demokratie.
 
Vor diesem Hintergrund wurde 2006 die Flossbach von Storch Stiftung gegründet. Ihre Aktivitäten sind in drei Bereiche gegliedert: Projektarbeit, Förderung von Wissenschaft, Forschung und Lehre sowie bildungspolitisches Engagement. Zur Unterstützung des Teams bei der Projektarbeit und um noch mehr Menschen zu erreichen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) in Köln mit 15 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche für mindestens 6 Monate.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Pflege und Ausbau unserer Social-Media-Kanäle (insbesondere Instagram und LinkedIn)
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung kreativer Content-Ideen (Text, Bild, Video, Reels) und Serien
  • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Abstimmung des Content Calendars
  • Pflege und Aktualisierung unserer Website
  • Interaktion mit unserer Community, Beantwortung von Kommentaren und Nachrichten
  • Auswertung der Content-Performance


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du hast Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Ideen und Konzepten und verfügst über eine hohe Affinität zu Social Media, insbesondere Instagram und LinkedIn
  • Kenntnisse: Du verfügst über Basiskenntnisse im Bereich Wirtschaft und Finanzen
  • Qualifikation: Du bist eingeschriebener Bachelor- ode

Das Data & Automation Team ist Teil der OMR Tech Abteilung und fungiert als Center of Excellence für die Daten- und Prozessoptimierung bei OMR. Was uns dabei leitet, ist bis heute dasselbe: Wir arbeiten nur mit Menschen zusammen, mit denen es wirklich passt, ob im Team oder mit unseren Mandanten. Denn gute Arbeit entsteht dort, wo Vertrauen herrscht, jede Stimme zählt und man gemeinsam Lösungen entwickelt. Diese Haltung macht uns aus und sie eröffnet Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich bei uns einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Deinen eigenen Weg in der Steuerberatung und in unserer Kanzlei zu gehen.

Aufgaben

title: Automation Engineer, Wet Lab
description:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

Today, bioprocess development is slow, expensive, and limited by the economics of lab hardware. A typical system runs 4, 8, or 24 bioreactors in parallel, and a single run can cost anywhere from hundreds to several thousand dollars. Our ambition is different: 100 parallel bioreactor runs at around $10 per run.

Why does that matter? Because radically reducing the cost per insight changes what is possible. Instead of running a handful of carefully selected experiments, we can generate dense, standardized datasets across thousands of conditions.

That data is at the core of Differential Bio. First, we automate high-throughput data generation. Then we use our proprietary datasets to train AI models that understand how bioprocesses behave across conditions and scales - with the long-term goal of building a digital twin of fermentation at any scale.

We have already built two end-to-end automated fermentation pods that operate continuously and generate experimental data every week. Being vertically integrated all the way down to the physical lab has proven to be a major advantage for us.

Now we are hiring the first role dedicated entirely to lab automation. You will take over this domain from our founder and CTO, Martin, report directly to him, and own how our automation platform develops from here.

This is, in many ways, the role we always wished existed: high autonomy, genuinely difficult engineering problems, the freedom and resources to solve them properly, and a mission worth the hard work

title: AI Growth Marketer (m/w/d) - remote

Wir sind ein kleines, agiles Marketing-Team. Jede und jeder übernimmt hier Ownership, entwickelt eigene Strategien und setzt sie selbst um. Seit wir konsequent mit AI arbeiten, sehen wir deutlich mehr Chancen zu wachsen, als wir bisher angehen können. title: Solution Architect (d/f/m)
description:
Gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment-Tech

Willkommen bei vivenu – dem globalen Vorreiter für Event-Ticketing-Technologie und einem der weltweit schnellst wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen im Live-Entertainment. Wir revolutionieren Ticketing für internationale Größen wie die Grammys, die Golden Globes, die Stanford University und den Hockenheimring – und machen aus einer einfachen Ticketing-Transaktion einen echten strategischen Wettbewerbsvorteil. Mit über 65 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung im Rücken ermöglicht unsere Plattform Veranstaltern, ihre Markenpräsenz selbst zu steuern, tiefgreifende Datenanalysen zu nutzen und Ticketing nahtlos in ihre digitale Infrastruktur zu integrieren.

Mit sechs Standorten weltweit bieten wir eine intuitive, individuell anpassbare Lösung und branchenführenden Support, der selbst die komplexesten Herausforderungen im Ticketing vereinfacht. So helfen wir Veranstaltern, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu erzielen.

Werde Teil unserer Mission – und gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment mit.

Als Solution Architect (d/f/m) bei vivenu gehören zu deinen Aufgaben:
  • Konzeptionierung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen für individuelle integration gaps, wie API-Anbindungen, Single Sign-On (SSO)-Setups und ERP-Systeme, unter optimaler Nutzung der leistungsstarken Plattform-Features von vivenu
  • Aufbau enger Partnerschaften mit Enterprise-Kunden, um deren bestehende digitale storefronts nahtlos in eine hochmoderne, vollständig auf unseren robusten APIs basierende Headless-Commerce-Architektur zu überführen
  • Durchführung technischer Workshops mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern auf Kundenseite – von CTOs und IT-Abteilungen bis hin zu externen Digitalagenturen und Ticketin

title: Teamleader Kundservice
description: ___________________________________________________________________________________________ Häng med på resan med Jollyroom – e-handeln som startade år 2010 och nu dominerar Nordens marknad som den största onlinebutiken för barn- och babyprodukter. Vi strävar efter att erbjuda inte bara produkter, utan en total livsstilsupplevelse, för föräldrar i Europa. Med över 2 miljoner nöjda kunder och ett sortiment som omfattar produkter för gravida, nyfödda och barn till 12 år, är vi inte bara en butik, vi är en destination för barnfamiljen. Vi brinner för att göra familjelivet enklare, roligare och mer inspirerande genom att erbjuda de bästa varumärkena och de senaste produkterna. Men vi nöjer oss inte där - vi är på en ständig resa mot att bli bäst i Europa. Vår nya bas, Campus Jollyroom strax utanför Göteborg, är en plats där innovation möter passion. Här huserar vårt stora, moderna kontor, toppmoderna lager på 55 000 kvm och ett showroom som tar kundupplevelsen till en ny nivå. Vi tror på att investera i våra 400 medarbetare, därför har vi även ett välutrustat stort personalgym på plats för att se till att vårt team är i toppform för att möta våra högt uppsatta mål. Men det slutar inte där. Med fysiska butiker i Stockholm och Oslo expanderar vi vårt grepp över den europeiska marknaden. Vi är inte bara med i spelet - vi är här för att vinna. Och du kan vara en del av det här vinnande laget. Vi letar ständigt efter talanger som delar vår passion och vår drivkraft att göra skillnad. Så om du är redo att vara en del av något stort, om du är hungrig efter utmaningar och redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär, då är Jollyroom platsen för dig.     Är du en driven, målinriktad och erfaren ledare som är redo för nästa etapp i ditt arbetsliv? Då kan du vara en av våra nästa Teamleaders på Kundserviceavdelningen! Just nu letar vi efter en Teamleader som säkerhetsställer att våra kunder får oslagbar service via mail och telefon samt att våra medarbetare utvecklas och presterar enligt uppsatta mål.    Din uppgift som Teamleader är att genom coachning och uppföljning se till så att ditt team uppnår våra KPI:er som i slutänden förbättrar kundupplevelsen. Din uppgift är även att säkerställa hantering utav olika administrativa ansvarsområden inom upsatta KPI:er, samt säkerställa utveckling i vårt kundservicesystem. I arbetet ingår det att ha nära samarbete med övriga Teamleaders och avdelningar för att ständigt utveckla verksamheten.   Dina arbetsuppgifter:     Löpande hantera personalfrågor.   Löpande hålla coachningssamtal, hälsosamtal och medarbetarsamtal.   Följer upp data och statistik för att säkerställa att avdelningen och medarbetare uppnår sina mål och arbetar mot verksamhetens mål.   Initierar och driver projekt för att utveckla och förbättra vår kundservice.   Ingår i ledningsgruppen för avdelningen och har ett nära samarbete med övriga Teamleaders och Head of Customer Service.   Personalrelaterade uppgifter, t.ex. godkänna löner, intervjua slutkandidater

Du står ikke alene med ansvaret. Du får en tæt sparringspartner i en erfaren servicelederkollega, ligesom vores koordinator hjælper med at skabe struktur og flow i hverdagen. description: ZARA  ist eine internationale Modekette der spanischen Inditex-Gruppe. Mit über 2.000 Filialen in mehr als 90 Ländern sind wir eines der erfolgreichsten Textilunternehmen weltweit.
