Con una forte presenza a livello europeo e una lunga storia di successo, Econocom offre un ambiente dinamico e stimolante per coloro che condividono la nostra passione per la tecnologia e per i valori dell’economia circolare.      Descrizione del Ruolo:  Stiamo cercando un/una  Account Manager  che abbia passione per le relazioni commerciali e voglia contribuire concretamente alla crescita del business. La persona avrà la responsabilità di sviluppare un portafoglio di clienti, costruendo relazioni solide e durature e individuando nuove opportunità di sviluppo. Attraverso una profonda comprensione delle esigenze dei clienti, proporrà soluzioni e servizi in linea con i loro bisogni e con la strategia aziendale, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali e alla crescita sostenibile del business.      Responsabilità Chiave:   Business Development   Identificare opportunità di upselling, cross-selling e ampliamento dei servizi.  Promuovere il portafoglio soluzioni e servizi dell’azienda presso i clienti assegnati.  Sviluppare piani commerciali per la crescita degli account.      Commercial Management   Predisporre offerte commerciali e negoziare condizioni economiche e contrattuali.  Gestire rinnovi contrattuali e attività di retention.  Garantire il raggiungimento dei target di fatturato e marginalità.      Client Relationship   Costruire e mantenere relazioni di lungo periodo con decision maker e stakeholder chiave.  Organizzare e condurre periodiche business review con i clienti.  Gestire eventuali escalation commerciali.      Internal Coordination   Collaborare con i team di delivery e operation per garantire la corretta esecuzione dei servizi.  Assicurare l’allineamento tra impegni commerciali, livelli di servizio e aspettative del cliente.  Favorire la collaborazione tra le funzioni coinvolte nella gestione dell’account.       Qualifiche:    Laurea o cultura equivalente in discipline economiche, commerciali o tecniche.  Esperienza pluriennale nella gestione di clienti B2B.  Conoscenza delle dinamiche di account management e customer relationship management.       Come Candidarsi:  Se possiedi le qualifiche richieste e sei pronto ad affrontare questa sfida, invia il tuo CV e la lettera di presentazione a recruiting@econocom.com o direttamente da LinkedIn.       Informativa ai sensi dell’art. 13 del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679     Ai sensi dell’art. 13 del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679 (GDPR) la informiamo che i Suoi dati personali saranno trattati da    Econocom Lease Solutions S.p.A.   , Titolare del trattamento, prevalentemente con mezzi informatici, per le attività di reclutamento e selezione del personale e saranno utilizzati esclusivamente per ricontattarla e pianificare un primo colloquio. title: Senior Business Operations Manager
description: The Opportunity   Unity's Entertainment CRO org is the growth and customer engagement engine for our Games and Entertainment customers. Within it, the Operations group exists to bring analytical rigor to how we set strategy and make decisions, ensure every customer-facing team is equipped to execute, and modernize how we engage with customers at scale.  We are hiring a Senior Business Operations Manager to modernize how our sales, success, support, and enablement functions run. Your job is to diagnose why a process isn’t working and design something better. The right answer is sometimes a redesigned process flow, and sometimes automation, a new system capability, or an AI-powered experience. You will take the reins on implementation and see it through. Sometimes, you will need to build automations and internal tools yourself and scale the larger ones with systems and data teams.  What you’ll do    Lead the implementation of AI-driven customer support experience, from designing the customer journey, managing the Help Center experience, to the implementation of customer support AI chatbot   Establish a structured feedback loop between support and relevant product teams that surfaces recurring issues and drives resolution at the root cause  Ensure customer-facing teams are enablement  Partner with support leaders to establish a process for maintaining the Knowledge Base that optimizes for self-service, AI enhancements, and support agent contributions  Drive the support and customer success, partnering with data teams on metric definitions, dashboard design, and automated reporting  Build automations and internal tools hands-on, and scale the larger builds in partnership with systems and data teams    What we’re looking for    Strong customer empathy and an appreciation for what makes a customer’s experience easy and seamless  Process- and detail-oriented with proven experience in redesigning operational processes and delivering measurable improvement  Structured thinking, with the ability to take a vague problem and produce a clear diagnosis, a set of options, and a defensible recommendation   Track record of driving cross-functional programs from concept through adoption, working through influence rather than authority  Technical skillsets or title: Digital Experience Manager Intelligence & Research
description: Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.   About The Role   Do you aspire to shape the future of digital travel experiences through customer intelligence, behavioural analytics, and innovation?  As Manager, Digital Experience Intelligence & Research, you will lead the research and analytics capability that drives customer-centric decision-making across Riyadh Air's digital ecosystem. You will transform customer behaviour, market trends, and digital performance data into actionable insights that influence product strategy, experience design, and business outcomes.  Working closely with Product, Experience Design, Technology, Data, and Commercial teams, you will identify opportunities for optimisation, validate concepts through research and experimentation, and provide strategic recommendations that enhance customer journeys across web, mobile, and emerging digital channels.  You will champion evidence-based decision-making by leveraging qualitative and quantitative research, behavioural insights, customer feedback, and industry best practices. Your expertise will help shape future digital experiences, support innovation initiatives, and ensure Riyadh Air remains at the forefront of customer experience excellence.  This is your opportunity to help build one of the world's most innovative airlines and redefine the future of digital customer experiences.   About You   Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 7 years in Customer Insights, UX Research, Digital Analytics, Behavioural Science, Market Research, or a related field, with a proven track record of delivering customer-focused business outcomes.  You possess strong experience in research methodologies, customer journey analysis, experimentation, stakeholder management, and translating complex data into clear, meaningful insights and recommendations.  We'd love to hear from you even more if you can demonstrate experience in AI-enabled research, digital experience optimisation, customer intelligence platforms, and agile product environments.  You will be recognised for your strategic thinking, communication skills, innovative mindset, and ability to influence stakeholders while driving a culture of continuous improvement.  This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.  Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

title: Operations Manager
description: Transcom is a global community of customer experience experts – nimble, driven, and committed to the brands we serve. Please include a full CV in English .     At Transcom, we’re relentlessly committed. To our clients and each other. Every day, someone starts their journey with Transcom. Taking the potential they have today and turning it into skills for the future. Getting recognized for working hard, being a team player, and supporting others. Championing positive, lasting change in their teams and communities. That’s just how we are at Transcom. Here we care and root for each other. You’re included, just as you are, from day one. And with the right mindset, there’s no end to how far we can go together.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: At Aceve, we back the builders of society. Founded in the Nordics and growing across Europe, we build digital tools for the people who construct and maintain our physical world - giving electricians, plumbers, and contractors back their time, clarity, and confidence. With over 900 employees across 8 countries, leading brands in 7 customer markets, and more than €100M in revenue, we're on an ambitious growth journey, and we're just getting started. We're an AI-first company, and we work with grit, openness, and a good dose of joy.   Role Purpose   As our Customer Success Manager, you'll make sure customers keep getting real value from Next, our project management and financial control platform for construction companies. Next gives project managers and site teams visibility into project economics, budgets, costs, revenue and progress, both on individual projects and across the business. You'll do that by keeping a close eye on customer health, engagement and usage, and catching risks and opportunities early.  This is a role for someone who wants to help build how Customer Success works, not just fit into it. Building the function is something the whole team owns together, and we're looking for someone who gets a real charge out of that. Someone who's comfortable when the path is a bit foggy and can bring structure to the mess.  We think one-to-many. The goal isn't just solving things for one customer at a time, it's finding ways to make things better for several customers at once. We'd rather build something that scales than lean on one-off 1:1 meetings.   Key Responsibilities     Proactively monitor customer health, engagement and usage, flag and act on risks before they escalate.  Think one-to-many: look for ways to improve things for several customers at once, rather than relying on one-off 1:1 meetings.  Run regular touchpoints and spot opportunities for customers to get more value.  Drive product adoption, retention and renewal, working closely with Account Management.  Be the customer's internal advocate, feeding insights back to Product and Support.  Help customers navigate product changes and new ways of working.  Help build and improve how Customer Success works. This is a shared team responsibility, not one role's job.  Share what you learn from customers so the whole team can keep improving.     Success Measures     Customer Health Score and proactive risk management  Product usage, engagement and adoption  Customer satisfaction and NPS  Retention, churn and renewal outcomes  Strength of customer relationships and stakeholder communication  Contribution to improving Customer Success processes and best practices     Required Competencies & Skills     Able to read product usage and customer data to spot risks and opportunities early. title: CRM & AI Automation Manager
description: Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir in unserem Hauptsitz in Rotkreuz per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung dich als:      CRM & AI Automation Manager (m/w/d) 100%       Deine Mission   Du gestaltest die daten- und KI-gestützte, hyperpersonalisierte Kundenkommunikation unserer Marken und sorgst dafür, dass wir unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zur richtigen Zeit mit der passenden Botschaft über den richtigen Kanal erreichen. Dafür verbindest du Kundenverständnis, CRM und Technologie, übersetzt Kundendaten in relevante Zielgruppen und leitest daraus personalisierte Kampagnen sowie konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Gemeinsam mit der IT sowie internen und externen Partnern setzt du diese in automatisierten Anwendungen und Prozessen um. So schaffst du personalisierte Kundenerlebnisse, stärkst die Kundenbindung und machst unser Marketing messbar wirksamer und effizienter.      Deine Hauptaufgaben    Entwicklung daten- und KI-gestützter Marketing- und CRM-Kampagnen entlang des gesamten Customer Lifecycles: von der Analyse von Kundenverhalten und Potenzialen bis zur personalisierten Ansprache über die passenden Kanäle  Analyse von Kunden-, Kampagnen- und Transaktionsdaten sowie Identifikation von Potenzialen für Kundenbindung, Cross-Selling, Up-Selling und Reaktivierung. Darauf basierend: Definition von Zielgruppen, Selektionslogiken und automatisierten Marketingmassnahmen  Konzeption und Optimierung automatisierter Customer Journeys für die mobilezone Gruppe, damit unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zur richtigen Zeit die relevantesten Angebote, Inhalte und Services erhalten  Strategische Weiterentwicklung des mobilezone Club mit datenbasierten Mehrwerten für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden durch personalisierte Benefits, Angebote und Kommunikationsmassnahmen  Vorantreiben der Transformation unserer heutigen CRM-Landschaft hin zu einer KI-gestützten Plattform für hyperpersonalisierte Kundenkommunikation und Erschliessen neuer Möglichkeiten für eine skalierbare, datengetriebene Kundenansprache  Identifikation und Implementierung von KI-Anwendungen entlang des gesamten Marketingprozesses: von Datenanalyse und Zielgruppenbildung über Content-Erstellung und Sprachadaption bis zur automatisierten Kampagnensteuerung und Erfolgsmessung  Verantwortung für CRM-, Automations- und Transformationsprojekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Kampagnenmanagement, IT sowie externen Technologiepartnern  Weiterentwicklung der Anbindung von KI-Tools, KI-Agenten und neuen Datenquellen an unsere Marketing- und CRM-Plattformen, damit Daten, Prozesse und Schnittstellen optimal aufeinander abgestimmt sind  Verantwortung für Qualität und Weiterentwicklung unserer Marketing- und Kundendaten als saubere Grundlage für erfolgreiche Personalisierung, Automatisierung und KI-Anwendungen       Das bringst Du mit:    Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Weiterbildung in Marketing, CRM, Data Analytics, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.  Erfahrung in CRM, datenbasie

title: Customer Success & Implementation Manager (AI B2B SaaS | German & French)
description: Willst Du unsere preisgekrönte Künstliche Intelligenz von morgen mitgestalten, die schon heute das Arbeitsleben von Tausenden von Menschen in acht Europäischen Ländern verbessert? Werde ein unverzichtbarer Teil unseres etablierten und dennoch dynamischen Startup-Teams!   Wir sind ein spezialisierter SaaS-Anbieter einer innovativen und datengetriebenen SaaS-Plattform zur Digitalisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen im Automotive Aftersales.   Unsere Kunden sind Werkstätten, Händlergruppen und international tätige Aftersalesketten. Unser Ziel: smartere Abläufe, bessere Entscheidungen und messbare Effizienzgewinne durch eine datengestützte und selbstlernende KI. Mit einem digitalen Zwilling bilden wir ganze Prozessstrassen (insb. im Bereich Karosserie & Lack) realitätsgetreu ab und finden mit einer Real-time Optimerung Potenziale, die sonst im Verborgenen bleiben. Hilf mit und verbessere die aspaara-KI um sie zur Killerplattform im Automotive Aftersales zu machen.   Effiziente und ressourcenschonende Lösungen liegen uns sehr am Herzen. Deshalb haben wir uns verpflichtet, ein 100% klimaneutrales Unternehmen zu sein. title: Global Sustainability Market Engagement Manager
description: The Opportunity   As Global Sustainability Market Engagement Manager, you will help the organisation systematically anticipate, understand, and respond to evolving customer and stakeholder sustainability expectations.  The role combines sustainability expertise with market and customer insight. You will develop structured and consistent approaches for managing sustainability-related requests, translate external signals into actionable business insights, and support customer-facing teams in strategic engagements.   How You'll Make An Impact    Market & Customer Sustainability Intelligence      Gather and structure sustainability expectations, requirements, and emerging priorities from customers and key stakeholders.   Monitor relevant market developments, regulatory evolution, competitive trends, and recurring sustainability themes.   Identify early signals, opportunities, and risks that may affect competitiveness, market access, and customer needs.   Translate complex inputs into clear, actionable insights for strategic and commercial decision-making.     Sustainability Request & Response Process Development      Develop and continuously improve a structured approach for managing sustainability-related customer and stakeholder requests.   Define clear intake, prioritisation, coordination, escalation, and response pathways.   Enable effective collaboration across Sustainability, Marketing & Sales, Portfolio, Product Management, Supply Chain, Communications, Legal, and other relevant functions.     Customer-Focused Sustainability Value      Translate sustainability capabilities, initiatives, and performance into clear and customer-relevant business value.   Support the development of sustainability value propositions and fact-based messages for customers and market stakeholders.   Contribute, where relevant, to the assessment of sustainability-related value drivers, business benefits, and competitive differentiators.   Help commercial and business teams communicate sustainability topics in a clear and business-oriented way.     Strategic Insight and Business Input      Translate customer and market insights into input for sustainability strategy, materiality assessments, portfolio development, and innovation.   Provide fact-based perspectives on evolving stakeholder expectations and their potential business implications.   Support the identification of opportunities where sustainability can create customer value and contribute to long-term growth.     Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement      Act as a bridge between Sustainability and customer-facing business functions.   Facilitate collaboration across functions and regions in a complex global organisation.   Support capability building by providing practical guidance, tools, and frameworks for sustainability discussions with customers and stakeholders.   Foster alignment while respecting established governance and decision-making responsibilities.     Your background

Du vil arbejde tæt på beslutningstagere og spille en nøglerolle i at udvikle vores kunders forretning gennem velfunderede og værdiskabende løsninger. Hvad du skal have med     Har erfaring med B2B- og løsningssalg samt med at opbygge og udvikle langsigtede kunderelationer.   Har en teknisk salgsbaggrund fx som salgsingeniør eller lignende.   Kan sætte dig ind i kundens forretning og se sammenhænge mellem driftsmæssige, økonomiske og tekniske behov.   Trives med et stort ansvar og møder kunderne med rådgivning, der tager udgangspunkt i deres behov og mulige løsninger.   Tager selv initiativ til at identificere nye salgsmuligheder og skabe yderligere værdi i eksisterende kunderelationer.   Sætter pris på en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor dine dage tilbringes ude hos kunderne.   Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med CRM-systemer og bruger data aktivt til at planlægge og følge op på salgsindsatsen.   Erfaring med Off- og on-shore kunder er en fordel.   Er bosat i Trekantområdet.     Hvad det giver dig   Hos Hilti får du et udviklende og meningsfuldt job med gode karrieremuligheder. Vi tilbyder:    Fuldt ansvar for nøglekunder med direkte indflydelse på kundens og Hilti Danmarks resultater.   Grundigt introduktionsforløb med bl.a. salgstræning, herunder to ugers salgstræning fordelt på to ophold på vores regionale træningscenter i Manchest

description: Är du redo för nästa utmaning? Får du energi av omväxling och snabbt tempo i en föränderlig miljö? Vår styrka är vår bredd av kompetens och vårt breda utbud av tjänster. Vi samarbetar mycket med övriga avdelningar och discipliner i regionen och delar lokal med både VS och Vitvaror. Är affärsmässig och engagerad ledare som motiveras av att utveckla inom installationsbranschen samt känsla och intresse för säljarbete och kundrelationer.  Arbetar strukturerat, tar egna initiativ och kommunicerar tydligt med kunder, kollegor och medarbetare.     Arbetet som servicechef kräver ofta snabba beslut och ageranden vilket medför att du bör vara stresstålig och ha god problemlösningsförmåga. Mycket stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.   Meriterande:      Har lokal förankring i Perstorp-Klippan-Hässleholm-Örkelljunga området med omnejd.  Har du även ett befintligt kontaktnät inom dessa områden är det starkt meriterande.  Du har en god struktur i ditt arbete och lätt för att kommunicera och samarbeta. title: Technical Account Manager, API Partnerships
description:
Headquarters:  San Diego, CA, USA
      URL:   http://www.shoutaboutus.com 
 

 Technical Account Manager, API Partnerships 
 Shout About Us · Remote (worldwide) · Full-time · 60K - 80K USD 
 About the role 
 We're hiring a Technical Account Manager to own and grow our most strategic accounts. You’ll own the technical relationship with our API partners, from their first technical evaluation through implementation and ongoing support. 
 Reporting directly to the CRO, you’ll be the first dedicated post-sales professional at Shout About Us, responsible for making sure our biggest customers deploy, expand, and stay. Our ICP is founders, product teams, and engineering teams.  
 This is a hands-on role. On any given day, you might join a prospect’s technical discovery call, troubleshoot an API request with a partner engineer, coordinate a fix with our engineering team, or improve a quickstart guide. You’ll also help build the documentation and processes that make each new integration easier than the last. 
 Location and hours 
 Remote, anywhere. Our standard working hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. US Eastern Time, including a lunch break. Occasional calls outside these hours are required for APAC partners and key implementation milestones. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 
 Own a portfolio of 10-15 strategic accounts. Be the primary technical contact for API partners, keep stakeholders informed, and follow issues through to resolution. 
 
 
 Support technical evaluations. Join sales calls, demonstrate API capabilities, understand the partner’s requirements, and explain how an integration would work. 
 
 
 Lead partner implementations. Turn requirements into a clear integration plan, guide developers through setup and testing, and track progress through launch. 
 
 
 Troubleshoot directly. Investigate requests, responses, logs, authentication issues, and integration behavior before escalating to engineering. 
 
 
 Work closely with engineering. Provide clear reproduction steps, relevant evidence, and customer impact when an issue needs deeper investigation. 
 
 
 Improve the developer experience. Create and maintain API guides, Postman collections, code examples, FAQs, and onboarding playbooks. 
 
 
 Identify recurring friction. Share partner feedback and integration patterns that can inform product improvements. 
 
 
 Lead expansion efforts. Cross-sell new features and products as a natural extension of the relationship, not a separate motion.  
 
 
 What we’re looking for 
 
 
 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role or equivalent at an API-first or dev-tools company 
 
 
 Strong practical understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, authentication, webhooks, pagination, and rate limits. 
 
 
 Comfort using Postman or curl, reading logs, and writing or adapting small code examples in a language such as JavaScript or Python. 
 
 
 Experience driving adoption inside complex orgs: navigating the gap between the buyer who signed and the team

AYAN reads how these models answer  real buyer questions, shows a brand where it is recommended and where a competitor takes its place,  and turns every gap into a fix that lands with the person or page that closes the sale.  Four founders. Live clients in retail, beauty and hospitality across the Gulf and Europe. Hiring the first two people who are not founders.      Why this role exists   Our first clients have signed. They did not buy a login. They bought a result: their brand read differently  by AI inside a set window, KPIs that move, and a story they will put their name on.  You own that, from onboarding to published case study. The founders sell and build. You make sure  what was sold gets delivered and what was built gets used. Three quarters of your time is clients. The  rest is running the project plan for AYAN's own marketing: launch, events, content, PR. When both are  on fire, the client is the one you put out.      A realistic Tuesday   09:10. A client's marketing lead messages you. The fix their web team promised last week has not  shipped and their monthly read is in three days. Paul is in a pitch. Chakir is in Riyadh. You have the  client's org chart, the platform, and forty minutes before your next call. Nobody is coming to tell you what  to do.  If that excites you more than it scares you, keep reading.      Who you are   Two to three years, probably agency or consulting, running accounts where the client was demanding  and the deadline was real. You have never worked on AI and that is fine. You are curious enough to  learn it in month one and clear enough to explain it to a marketing director in month two.   •  You finish things. An ownerless project finds you and you take it.   •  You find the fix before you find someone to escalate to.   •  No process yet? You write it.   •  You read a spreadsheet and a client's mood with the same attention.   •  English a client never questions. Arabic is a real advantage.  One more thing. Whatever channel you apply through, make your first line the last brand an AI assistant recommended to you, and whether you bought it. That is how we know you got this far.      Six months in    •  Every open fix has a named owner on the client side, and you know which ones are stuck and why.   •  One client has agreed in writing to a named case study, and you drove the proof points behind it.   •  Onboarding takes half the time it does today, because you rewrote it.   •  We hear about client problems from you before the client tells us. title: AI Success Partner (Customer Success)
description: About the Company      About FileAIFileAI is building the future of intelligent document processing. We help enterprises automate extraction, classification, and analysis of unstructured data at scale. Our platform combines proprietary large language models with deep workflow integration to turn documents into structured, actionable output — in seconds, not hours. We're a fast-growing team with customers across financial services, insurance, legal, and logistics, and we're backed by leading regional investors.      About the Role      We're looking for a AI Success Partner to own the post-sale experience for a portfolio of FileAI customers. You'll be the primary point of contact from onboarding through renewal, ensuring customers achieve measurable outcomes and expand their use of the platform over time. This is a foundational role on a growing Customer Success team — you'll have direct exposure to product, engineering, and sales leadership, with a clear path to senior CSM or account management responsibilities.      Responsibilities       Own onboarding: Lead new customers through implementation, from kickoff to first value, ensuring smooth integration and clear adoption milestones.  Drive outcomes: Work with customers to define success metrics, track progress against goals, and demonstrate ROI throughout the relationship.  Build relationships: Develop trusted advisor status with key stakeholders — from operations leads to C-suite sponsors — through proactive engagement and strategic counsel.  Expand revenue: Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within your book, partnering with Sales to grow account value.  Protect revenue: Monitor health signals, address churn risk early, and own the renewal process end-to-end.  Be the voice of the customer: Distill customer feedback into actionable product insights and advocate for customer needs internally.  Improve processes: Contribute to playbooks, templates, and CS tooling as we scale the function.       Required Skills       1–3 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a client-facing role at a B2B SaaS or technology company.  Track record of owning outcomes: You've managed a book of business, hit retention or expansion targets, or led customers through complex implementations.  Strong communicator: You can translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences and build rapport quickly across seniority levels.  Organised and detail-oriented: You manage multiple workstreams without dropping balls, and you're comfortable in CRM and project management tools.  Problem-solver: You diagnose root causes, escalate effectively, and don't stop until the customer is unblocked.  Comfort with ambiguity: We're early-stage and evolving fast. You thrive in environments where processes are being built, not just followed.       What We Offer       Competitive salary and performance-based bonus  Unlimited leave  Lunch Perks  Direct access to founders and leadership

title: Lead Implementation manager
description: Lead Implementation Manager       About Yomly   Yomly is a Dubai-based HR and payroll automation SaaS provider serving organisations across the GCC and beyond. We help customers turn agreed requirements into a working service: confident platform adoption, reliable payroll and a clear handover into ongoing support.      The opportunity   We are looking for a senior, hands-on implementation leader to personally deliver high-value customer projects, guide our delivery team and strengthen how Yomly manages implementations.  You will lead projects from discovery and agreed scope through go-live and early stabilisation, bringing discipline to planning, portfolio visibility and customer communication.  You will work with a team of six delivery colleagues and a Training Consultant. Professional Services is a separate engineering and customisation function: Engineering owns technical feasibility, estimates and what gets built; you own the customer plan, scope and delivery outcome.  Your primary contribution is trusted hands-on delivery. You will normally own one or two substantial implementations at a time, delegating defined activities while retaining ownership of decisions, progress and customer outcomes. Build workable plans covering configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, training, cutover and stabilisation.  Run customer workshops and delivery meetings; resolve ambiguity and address difficult conversations directly.  Manage scope changes, effort and delivery forecasts as customer readiness or dependencies change.   Manage delivery constraints   Identify gaps between customer expectations and supported product capability during scoping.  Work with Sales, Product and Professional Services to agree a supported approach, workaround, scope change or escalation.  Validate technical feasibility and development commitments before incorporating them into a customer plan.  Contribute delivery judgement to higher-risk opportunities before signature and improve sales-to-implementation handovers.  Keep paused projects under active review, with clear owners and restart conditions.   Improve delivery across the portfolio   Maintain an accurate view of active implementations, including ownership, milestones, confidence, effort, risks, blockers and decisions required.  Lead short delivery reviews focused on exceptions, workload and actions.  Establish practical, lightweight delivery practices: reusable plans, scope records, readiness checks and handover criteria.  Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support and Customer Success to resolve recurring delivery issues.   Lead and develop the team   Allocate work according to capability and capacity.  Review plans and customer updates, provide feedback and coach colleagues through live delivery situations.  Manage

title: Vice President of Account Management
description: About Us   At Office Ally, we've been revolutionizing healthcare administration since our inception. What started as a clearinghouse focused on simplifying insurance claims processing for healthcare providers has grown into a full-suite healthcare technology company. We offer a range of affordable, cloud-based revenue cycle management solutions –from eligibility verification and claims management to revenue recovery and payment processing –that help healthcare organizations of all sizes streamline operations and reduce administrative burdens so they can focus on what matters most: patient care.  In April 2026, Office Ally acquired Jopari Solutions, Inc, a leader in straight-through electronic claims processing for Property & Casualty (P&C), Commercial, and Government healthcare. Jopari brings deep industry expertise and innovative enterprise payment solutions that are transforming how disbursements are handled across the insurance ecosystem. Together, we are expanding our capabilities across the full healthcare transaction lifecycle, connecting claims, payments, and data exchange to deliver a more seamless and efficient experience for providers, payers, and partners.  At the core of our company are four key values that guide our mission and work:     Ownership : We take pride in our responsibilities, driving results and taking accountability for the success of our projects.    Empowerment : We believe in giving our team the autonomy and support to make decisions that lead to innovative solutions.    Innovation : We continuously seek new and better ways to improve healthcare administration, embracing creativity and forward-thinking technology.    Transparent Communication : Open, honest communication is at the heart of our collaborations, internally and with our clients, ensuring alignment and trust.      About the Role   This position is responsible for taking full ownership of customer growth, retention, and satisfaction—focusing primarily on Office Ally's top 250 customers by revenue and revenue potential. This executive will be responsible for building and scaling a results-driven account management organization that drives impact where it matters most. This position will lead hiring, define KPIs, implement structured best practices, and actively engage with high-value customers both remotely and in person to maximize long-term partnerships and lifetime value   What You'll Do    Strategy & Transformation       Create and implement an account management function to support the business to include processes that influence claims submission timelines and revenue realization.    Build and execute a scalable strategy that supports company growth and delivers measurable impact.    Define KPIs and reporting frameworks to track performance (e.g. NRR, churn, CSAT, NPS).       Team Leadership      Lead, grow, and develop a high-performing Account Management team   Foster a customer-centric culture of accountability, continuous improvement

title: Account Management Lead
description: 플렉스팀의 Account Management Lead는 Account Management 팀을 이끌며, 고객 유지와 확장 성장 전반을 책임지는 리더입니다.      AM팀은 성격이 다른 두 고객 테리토리를 담당합니다.        하나는 Mid-Market 이상 규모의 Key Account로, 제품을 중심으로 복잡한 이해관계자 구조 속에서 데이터 기반으로 고객 여정을 설계하고 갱신·확장을 리딩해야 하는 고객군입니다.     다른 하나는 조직 규모는 SMB지만 HR Partners/Payroll Partners 등 People Service가 결합되어 대표·C-level과 직접 소통하며 복합 서비스 계약을 비즈니스 관점에서 조율해야 하는 고객군입니다.       AM Lead는 규모와 계약 구조, 요구 역량이 전혀 다른 이 두 테리토리를 깊이 이해하고, 하나의 팀 전략과 일관된 운영 체계로 통합해내는 역할입니다. 단순한 팀 관리를 넘어, 리텐션·확장 매출 목표에 대한 최종 오너십을 갖고 플레이북과 지표 체계를 설계하며, 팀원 개개인이 각자의 테리토리에서 성과를 낼 수 있도록 코칭하며 전략과 실행을 오가는 플레잉 리드로서 주요 고객을 직접 다루는 역할도 함께 수행합니다.         이런 일을 함께 하게 됩니다.      팀 리딩 & 전략     AM 팀의 리텐션, 업셀/크로스셀, 리뉴얼 목표를 설계하고 달성을 책임집니다.    Key Account와 Partners 테리토리 각각의 특성에 맞는 KPI·헬스스코어·운영 지표 체계를 설계하고, NRR 관점에서 팀 성과를 통합 관리합니다.    고객 세그먼트별 플레이북(갱신, 이탈 방어, 업셀/크로스셀 제안)을 표준화하고 지속적으로 고도화합니다.    팀원별 테리토리·어카운트 배분, 목표 설정, 1on1 코칭, 채용을 통해 팀의 성장을 이끕니다.        고객 & 매출 오너십     전사적으로 중요한 Key Account 및 전략 고객을 직접 담당하거나, 주요 갱신·확장 협상에 에스컬레이션 파트너로 참여합니다.    이탈 리스크 시그널을 팀 차원에서 조기에 식별하는 체계를 만들고, 대응 전략의 실행을 리딩합니다.    복잡한 계약 구조(제품 + People Service 조합, 가격 정책, 리뉴얼 조건)에 대한 협상 기준과 가이드를 수립합니다.        크로스펑셔널 협업     Implementation Team에서 온보딩을 마친 고객을 AM 팀이 안정적으로 인계받는 핸드오프 체계를 정비하고 운영합니다.    Product, CXM, Partners Service(HR/Payroll), Sales 등 유관 조직과의 협업 구조를 설계하고, 고객 인사이트가 제품·서비스 개선으로 이어지는 루프를 만듭니다.    고객 데이터(MRR, 사용률, 헬스스코어, 계약 구조)를 기반으로 경영진에 리텐션·확장 현황과 전략을 보고합니다.          이런 분과 함께 하고 싶습니다.       B2B SaaS 또는 IT 서비스 업계에서 풍부한 Account Management / Customer Success / Sales 경험을 갖고 계신 분     리텐션·NRR·확장 매출 등 정량 목표에 대한 최종 오너십을 갖고 팀 단위 성과를 만들어본 분    서로 다른 고객 테리토리(Mid-Market 이상, SMB)를 동시에 운영하거나, 테리토리 설계·배분을 직접 해본 경험이 있는 분    헬스스코어, 이탈 지표 등 데이터 기반으로 고객 운영 체계를 만들고, 플레이북으로 팀에 정착시켜본 분    대표·C-level 등 최고 의사결정자와의 협상과, 실무~의사결정자에 걸친 복잡한 이해관계자 관리 모두에 능숙한 분    플레잉 리드로서 직접 고객을 다루는 것과 팀을 통해 성과를 내는 것 사이의 균형을 잡을 수 있는 분    제품, 서비스 운영, 고객지원 등 유관 조직과 협업 구조를 설계하고 조율해본 분          이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋겠습니다.       HR SaaS 또는 HR/Payroll 도메인에 대한 이해가 있는 분    제품과 운영 서비스(BPO, 컨설팅, 매니지드 서비스)가 결합된 비즈니스 모델을 경험해본 분    체계가 잡힌 조직에서 AM/CS 팀을 운영해본 경험이 있고, 검증된 운영 체계(목표 관리, 코칭, 평가 등)를 성장 단계의 조직에 맞게 이식할 수 있는 분    복잡한 계약 구조(멀티 프로덕트, 서비스 조합, 갱신 조건)의 협상을 직접 리딩해본 분    Salesforce, Pipedrive 등 CRM 기반의 세일즈/CS 운영 체계를 구축해본 분          합류 여정을 안내드립니다       서류 전형 >  Pre-Interview(화상)> Job Interview > Peer Interview > Fit Interview > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 순서로 진행됩니다.

title: Lead Client Success Manager
description: Opentext - The Information Company   OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.   AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.   At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us. You will work closely with Sales, Renewals, Client Management and Premium Services stakeholders to uncover client needs, shape value-led propositions and support the renewal of existing Premium contracts. Create qualified pipeline by positioning the Premium portfolio as a value driver for adoption, operational resilience and client success. title: Senior Manager, Head of Customer Experience – France (H/F)
description: Pourquoi rejoindre Stryker?    Vous cherchez un endroit qui valorise vos talents uniques ? Découvrez la culture primée de Stryker.    Chez Stryker, nous plaçons l’expérience client au cœur de nos priorités. En tant que  Senior Manager, Head of Customer Experience , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la transformation de la stratégie européenne en excellence opérationnelle, en garantissant des résultats clients durables tout en développant les équipes et la performance de l’organisation.  Vous aurez l’opportunité de piloter une organisation à fort impact, d’accompagner la transformation des opérations et de contribuer directement à la satisfaction des clients, à l’amélioration continue et à la croissance de l’entreprise.   Le poste étant rattaché à une équipe internationale, nous vous remercions de bien vouloir soumettre votre CV en anglais.    Ce que vous ferez     Définissez et déployez la feuille de route régionale Customer Experience en alignement avec les objectifs européens, les processus Order-to-Cash et les priorités clients.  Pilotez la performance opérationnelle en matière d’expérience client, de qualité de service, de productivité, de conformité et de maîtrise des coûts à travers des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI).  Mettez en œuvre des initiatives de standardisation, de simplification et d’amélioration continue afin d’optimiser l’efficacité opérationnelle et les résultats clients.  Dirigez le déploiement de programmes de transformation, incluant la digitalisation, l’automatisation et la conduite du changement.  Collaborez avec les équipes Commerciales, Supply Chain, Finance, Qualité et Affaires Réglementaires pour résoudre les défis opérationnels et améliorer l’expérience client.  Suivez et améliorez les indicateurs de performance tels que les niveaux de service (SLA), les tableaux de bord opérationnels et les indicateurs financiers.  Pilotez la planification des effectifs, l’allocation des ressources et l’équilibrage des charges de travail afin d’assurer la stabilité et la montée en charge des opérations.  Développez les managers et les leaders de l’organisation grâce au coaching, à la gestion des talents et à la planification de la succession.     Ce dont vous aurez besoin    Qualifications Requises     Diplôme de niveau Bac+3 en Commerce, Logistique, Supply Chain, Gestion des Opérations ou domaine équivalent.  Minimum 10 ans d’expérience professionnelle au sein d’une organisation internationale.  Minimum 5 ans d’expérience en management dans les domaines Customer Experience, Service Client, Opérations, Supply Chain ou fonctions équivalentes orientées client.  Expérience avérée dans la gestion d’équipes opérationnelles multiculturelles et multi-pays.  Expérience confirmée dans la conduite de programmes de transformation, de changement organisationnel ou d’amélioration continue.  Solides compétences en leadership, communication, coaching, influence et gestion des projets.  Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l’anglais.

title: Head of Flexibility Solutions
description: Do you want to lead one of the most exciting growth areas in the Nordic energy market?      As Head of Flexibility Solutions, you lead the strategic development, commercial growth, and operational excellence of Mind Energy’s flexibility business.     You’re leading a multidisciplinary domain being responsible for flexibility products, ancillary services, market participation, and the digital platform that enables it all. Working at the intersection of business, technology, operations, and energy markets, you will create scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer value while strengthening Mind Energy's position as a leading flexibility partner in the Nordics.         DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE   At Mind Energy, we organize around domains rather than traditional functional silos.     Each domain brings together commercial, operational, product, and technical capabilities around a shared business objective and customer outcome. This enables faster decision-making, stronger ownership, and closer collaboration across the value chain.     In this role you lead the Flexibility Domain and bring together commercial specialists, traders, product experts, developers, and operations professionals around a common mission: delivering market-leading flexibility solutions that create customer value and accelerate the energy transition.      Your mission is to:    Define and lead the Flexibility Domain strategy, priorities, and roadmap, ensuring long-term business performance, growth, value creation, and market readiness.  Drive the commercial development of flexibility solutions by translating customer needs, market developments, commercial opportunities, and regulatory changes into scalable products, services, business capabilities, and system initiatives.  Co-own the roadmap and evolution of the Energy Trading Management Platform with the Product Owner, guiding investment and prioritization decisions across products, processes, and technology to deliver measurable business value.  Ensure operational excellence across activation, monitoring, settlement, and performance management, while acting as the escalation point for critical commercial, operational, market, and system challenges and maintaining deep insight into Nordic balancing markets, ancillary services, and TSO requirements.  Lead and develop a high-performing team built on ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, turning market complexity into clear priorities, scalable solutions, and tangible results.          JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS   Working alongside commercial specialists, traders, developers, product experts, and operations professionals, you join a high-performing, cross-functional domain with end-to-end ownership of our flexibility business.     Combining deep market expertise with commercial, operational, and technical capabilities, the team has the mandate to make decisions that directly impact our products, customers, and business results
